```ts
    const created = await insertUser(db, { role: "operator", sectorId, name });
    return {
      userId: created.id,
      name,
      email: `${created.id}@example.test`,
      role: "operator",
      sectorId,
    };
  };
  const adminUser = await insertUser(db, {
    role: "admin",
    sectorId: null,
    name: "Admin Teste",
  });
  const people: DashboardWorld["people"] = {
    ana: await operatorOf("Ana Teste", uld.id),
    bia: await operatorOf("Bia Teste", uld.id),
    cris: await operatorOf("Cris Teste", camara.id),
    duda: await operatorOf("Duda Teste", inactive.id),
    admin: {
      userId: adminUser.id,
      name: "Admin Teste",
      email: `${adminUser.id}@example.test`,
      role: "admin",
      sectorId: null,
    },
  };

  const shiftOf = async (
    sectorId: string,
    name: string,
    startsAt: string,
    endsAt: string,
    sortOrder: number,
    active = true,
  ): Promise<string> =>
    (
      await insertShift(db, {
        sectorId,
        name,
        startsAt,
        endsAt,
        sortOrder,
        active,
        createdAt: OLD,
      })
    ).id;
  const shifts: DashboardWorld["shifts"] = {
    morning: await shiftOf(uld.id, "Manhã", "06:00", "14:00", 1),
    afternoon: await shiftOf(uld.id, "Tarde", "14:00", "22:00", 2),
    night: await shiftOf(uld.id, "Noite", "22:00", "06:00", 3),
    retired: await shiftOf(uld.id, "Turno Antigo", "10:00", "18:00", 0, false),
    camaraDay: await shiftOf(camara.id, "Dia", "07:00", "19:00", 1),
    parado: await shiftOf(inactive.id, "Único", "08:00", "17:00", 1),
  };

  const lateItem = spDate("2026-11-20", "14:55");
  const itemOf = async (
    sectorId: string,
    name: string,
    unit: string,
    kind: ItemKind,
    sortOrder: number,
    options: { active?: boolean; createdAt?: Date } = {},
  ): Promise<string> => {
    const created = await insertItem(db, {
      sectorId,
      name,
      unit,
      kind,
      sortOrder,
      active: options.active ?? true,
    });
    await db
      .update(itemTable)
      .set({ createdAt: options.createdAt ?? OLD })
      .where(eq(itemTable.id, created.id));
    return created.id;
  };
  const items: DashboardWorld["items"] = {
    net: await itemOf(uld.id, "Rede de proteção", "rede", "control", 1),
    strap: await itemOf(uld.id, "Cinta", "peça", "control", 2),
    stretch: await itemOf(uld.id, "Stretch", "rolo", "stock", 3),
    oldStrap: await itemOf(uld.id, "Cinta antiga", "peça", "control", 4, {
      active: false,
    }),
    uldSeal: await itemOf(uld.id, "Lacre ULD", "unidade", "control", 5, {
      createdAt: lateItem,
    }),
    film: await itemOf(uld.id, "Filme", "rolo", "stock", 6, {
      createdAt: lateItem,
    }),
    seal: await itemOf(camara.id, "Lacre", "unidade", "control", 1),
    thermalBox: await itemOf(camara.id, "Caixa térmica", "caixa", "stock", 2),
    tape: await itemOf(inactive.id, "Fita", "rolo", "control", 1),
  };

  const shiftNames: Record<ShiftKey, string> = {
    morning: "Manhã",
    afternoon: "Tarde",
    night: "Noite",
    retired: "Turno Antigo",
    camaraDay: "Dia",
    parado: "Único",
  };
  const handovers: Partial<Record<WorldHandoverKey, string>> = {};
  for (const spec of HANDOVER_SPECS) {
    const delivered = spec.delivered;
    const confirmed = spec.confirmed;
    const created = await insertHandover(db, {
      sectorId: sectorIds[spec.sector],
      shiftId: shifts[spec.shift],
      operationalDate: spec.date,
      status: spec.status,
      ...(delivered
        ? {
            shiftNameSnapshot: shiftNames[spec.shift],
            deliveredBy: people[delivered.by].userId,
            deliveredAt: at(delivered.at),
          }
        : { updatedBy: people.ana.userId }),
      ...(confirmed
        ? {
            confirmedBy: people[confirmed.by].userId,
            confirmedAt: at(confirmed.at),
          }
        : {}),
    });
    handovers[spec.key] = created.id;
    for (const [itemKey, quantity] of spec.lines) {
      await insertHandoverItem(db, {
        handoverId: created.id,
        itemId: items[itemKey],
        quantity,
        snapshot: true,
      });
    }
  }

  // A correção é a operação real (spec §12): Rede de proteção 5 → 8 na 17T.
  const corrected = handovers["17T"];
  if (corrected === undefined) throw new Error("mundo: falta a passagem 17T");
  const correction = await correctHandover(
    db,
    people.admin,
    {
      id: corrected,
      reason: "Contagem conferida no depósito",
      occurrencesText: "",
      nextShiftText: "",
      items: [
        { itemId: items.net, quantity: 8, note: "" },
        { itemId: items.strap, quantity: 4, note: "" },
        { itemId: items.stretch, quantity: 5, note: "" },
      ],
    },
    spDate("2026-11-18", "09:00"),
  );
  if (!correction.ok) throw new Error("mundo: a correção da 17T falhou");

  const doca = await insertDestination(db, { name: "Doca 3" });
  const docaAntiga = await insertDestination(db, {
    name: "Doca Antiga",
    active: false,
  });
  const requests: Partial<Record<WorldRequestKey, string>> = {};
  for (const spec of REQUEST_SPECS) {
    const last = spec.events.at(-1);
    const author =
      spec.sector === "parado"
        ? people.duda
        : spec.sector === "camara"
          ? people.cris
          : people.ana;
    const destination =
      spec.destination === "doca"
        ? { destinationId: doca.id }
        : spec.destination === "inactive"
          ? { destinationId: docaAntiga.id }
          : { destinationOther: spec.destination.other };
    const created = await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: sectorIds[spec.sector],
      createdBy: author.userId,
      ...destination,
      status: last ? last[0] : "requested",
      createdAt: at(spec.createdAt),
      statusChangedAt: at(last ? last[1] : spec.createdAt),
      events: false,
    });
    requests[spec.key] = created.id;
    await insertRequestEvent(db, {
      requestId: created.id,
      fromStatus: null,
      toStatus: "requested",
      changedBy: author.userId,
      changedAt: at(spec.createdAt),
    });
    let from: RequestStatus = "requested";
    for (const [toStatus, when] of spec.events) {
      await insertRequestEvent(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        fromStatus: from,
        toStatus,
        changedBy: author.userId,
        changedAt: at(when),
      });
      from = toStatus;
    }
    for (const [itemKey, quantity] of spec.items) {
      await insertRequestItem(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        itemId: items[itemKey],
        quantity,
      });
    }
  }

  await deactivateSector(db, inactive.id);

  return {
    now,
    today: "2026-11-20",
    period: { period: "7", from: "2026-11-14", to: "2026-11-20" },
    previous: { from: "2026-11-07", to: "2026-11-13" },
    uld,
    camara,
    inactive,
    shifts,
    items,
    people,
    handovers: completeKeys(
      handovers,
      HANDOVER_SPECS.map((s) => s.key),
    ),
    requests: completeKeys(
      requests,
      REQUEST_SPECS.map((s) => s.key),
    ),
    correctedHandoverId: corrected,
    destinations: { doca: doca.id, inactive: docaAntiga.id },
  };
}

// Prova (em tempo de execução) que todas as chaves do mapa foram criadas.
function completeKeys<K extends string>(
  partial: Partial<Record<K, string>>,
  keys: readonly K[],
): Record<K, string> {
  const entries = keys.map((key): [K, string] => {
    const id = partial[key];
    if (id === undefined) throw new Error(`mundo: falta ${key}`);
    return [key, id];
  });
  // Único cast permitido (exceção documentada nas Global Constraints): o
  // TypeScript não prova que `Object.fromEntries` tem todas as chaves K, mas o
  // laço acima acabou de verificar, em tempo de execução, cada uma delas.
  return Object.fromEntries(entries) as Record<K, string>;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Leitores crus: SELECT simples, sem agregação, sem `min`, sem historySource
// nem fragmento do domínio. O oráculo calcula tudo em JS sobre eles.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type RawShift = {
  id: string;
  sectorId: string;
  name: string;
  startsAt: string;
  endsAt: string;
  active: boolean;
  sortOrder: number;
  createdAt: Date;
};
export type RawHandover = {
  id: string;
  sectorId: string;
  shiftId: string;
  operationalDate: string;
  status: HandoverStatus;
  deliveredAt: Date | null;
  corrected: boolean;
};
export type RawDeliveredItem = {
  itemId: string;
  handoverId: string;
  shiftId: string;
  operationalDate: string;
  quantity: number;
};
export type RawRequest = {
  id: string;
  destinationId: string | null;
  createdAt: Date;
  status: RequestStatus;
  events: { toStatus: RequestStatus; changedAt: Date }[];
  items: { itemId: string; name: string; unit: string; quantity: number }[];
};

export async function rawShifts(
  db: TestDb,
  sectorIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<RawShift[]> {
  if (sectorIds.length === 0) return [];
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: shiftTable.id,
      sectorId: shiftTable.sectorId,
      name: shiftTable.name,
      startsAt: shiftTable.startsAt,
      endsAt: shiftTable.endsAt,
      active: shiftTable.active,
      sortOrder: shiftTable.sortOrder,
      createdAt: shiftTable.createdAt,
    })
    .from(shiftTable)
    .where(inArray(shiftTable.sectorId, [...sectorIds]));
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    startsAt: fromDbTime(row.startsAt),
    endsAt: fromDbTime(row.endsAt),
  }));
}

export async function rawHandovers(
  db: TestDb,
  sectorIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<RawHandover[]> {
  if (sectorIds.length === 0) return [];
  return db
    .select({
      id: handover.id,
      sectorId: handover.sectorId,
      shiftId: handover.shiftId,
      operationalDate: handover.operationalDate,
      status: handover.status,
      deliveredAt: handover.deliveredAt,
      corrected: sql<boolean>`exists (select 1 from handover_correction c where c.handover_id = "handover"."id")`,
    })
    .from(handover)
    .where(inArray(handover.sectorId, [...sectorIds]));
}

export async function rawDeliveredItems(
  db: TestDb,
  input: {
    sectorIds: readonly string[];
    range: DateRange;
    kind: ItemKind;
  },
): Promise<RawDeliveredItem[]> {
  if (input.sectorIds.length === 0) return [];
  return db
    .select({
      itemId: handoverItem.itemId,
      handoverId: handoverItem.handoverId,
      shiftId: handover.shiftId,
      operationalDate: handover.operationalDate,
      quantity: handoverItem.quantity,
    })
    .from(handoverItem)
    .innerJoin(handover, eq(handover.id, handoverItem.handoverId))
    .where(
      and(
        inArray(handover.sectorId, [...input.sectorIds]),
        inArray(handover.status, ["delivered", "confirmed"]),
        gte(handover.operationalDate, input.range.from),
        lte(handover.operationalDate, input.range.to),
        eq(handoverItem.itemKindSnapshot, input.kind),
      ),
    );
}

export async function rawRequests(
  db: TestDb,
  sectorIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<RawRequest[]> {
  if (sectorIds.length === 0) return [];
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: request.id,
      destinationId: request.destinationId,
      createdAt: request.createdAt,
      status: request.status,
    })
    .from(request)
    .where(inArray(request.sectorId, [...sectorIds]));
  const ids = rows.map((row) => row.id);
  if (ids.length === 0) return [];
  const events = await db
    .select({
      requestId: requestStatusEvent.requestId,
      toStatus: requestStatusEvent.toStatus,
      changedAt: requestStatusEvent.changedAt,
    })
    .from(requestStatusEvent)
    .where(inArray(requestStatusEvent.requestId, ids))
    .orderBy(asc(requestStatusEvent.seq));
  const lines = await db
    .select({
      requestId: requestItem.requestId,
      itemId: requestItem.itemId,
      name: requestItem.itemNameSnapshot,
      unit: requestItem.itemUnitSnapshot,
      quantity: requestItem.quantity,
    })
    .from(requestItem)
    .where(inArray(requestItem.requestId, ids));
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    events: events
      .filter((event) => event.requestId === row.id)
      .map((event) => ({
        toStatus: event.toStatus,
        changedAt: event.changedAt,
      })),
    items: lines
      .filter((line) => line.requestId === row.id)
      .map((line) => ({
        itemId: line.itemId,
        name: line.name,
        unit: line.unit,
        quantity: line.quantity,
      })),
  }));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Oráculos: JS puro sobre os leitores crus. As regras estão escritas aqui, não
// importadas do SQL do dashboard.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function daysOf(range: DateRange): string[] {
  const days: string[] = [];
  for (let day = range.from; day <= range.to; day = addDays(day, 1)) {
    days.push(day);
  }
  return days;
}

const inRange = (day: string, range: DateRange) =>
  day >= range.from && day <= range.to;

const isDelivered = (status: HandoverStatus) =>
  status === "delivered" || status === "confirmed";

// Passagens: pares (turno ativo × dia ≥ dia da criação do turno em São Paulo)
// já encerrados; entregue = delivered/confirmed do período; "aguardando" = a
// entregue mais recente do setor (qualquer data) por (deliveredAt, id).
export function oraclePassages(input: {
  shifts: readonly RawShift[];
  handovers: readonly RawHandover[];
  sectorIds: readonly string[];
  period: DateRange;
  now: Date;
}): PassagesData {
  const inScope = (sectorId: string) => input.sectorIds.includes(sectorId);
  const delivered = input.handovers.filter(
    (h) =>
      inScope(h.sectorId) &&
      isDelivered(h.status) &&
      inRange(h.operationalDate, input.period),
  );

  const latestBySector = new Map<string, RawHandover>();
  for (const h of input.handovers) {
    if (!inScope(h.sectorId) || !isDelivered(h.status) || !h.deliveredAt) {
      continue;
    }
    const best = latestBySector.get(h.sectorId);
    const bestAt = best?.deliveredAt?.getTime() ?? Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
    if (
      best === undefined ||
      h.deliveredAt.getTime() > bestAt ||
      (h.deliveredAt.getTime() === bestAt && h.id > best.id)
    ) {
      latestBySector.set(h.sectorId, h);
    }
  }

  let confirmed = 0;
  let awaiting = 0;
  let unconfirmed = 0;
  for (const h of delivered) {
    if (h.status === "confirmed") confirmed += 1;
    else if (latestBySector.get(h.sectorId)?.id === h.id) awaiting += 1;
    else unconfirmed += 1;
  }

  let expected = 0;
  let missing = 0;
  for (const s of input.shifts) {
    if (!s.active || !inScope(s.sectorId)) continue;
    const created = saoPauloParts(s.createdAt).date;
    for (const day of daysOf(input.period)) {
      if (day < created) continue;
      if (!hasShiftEnded(day, s, input.now)) continue;
      expected += 1;
      const hasDelivery = input.handovers.some(
        (h) =>
          h.sectorId === s.sectorId &&
          h.shiftId === s.id &&
          h.operationalDate === day &&
          isDelivered(h.status),
      );
      if (!hasDelivery) missing += 1;
    }
  }

  return {
    expected,
    delivered: delivered.length,
    confirmed,
    awaiting,
    unconfirmed,
    missing,
    listed: delivered.length + missing,
  };
}

export type OracleControlItem = {
  itemId: string;
  total: number;
  previousTotal: number;
  handoverCount: number;
  average: number | null;
  byShift: Record<string, { total: number; previousTotal: number }>;
  byDay: Record<string, number>;
};

// Controles: `lines` são as linhas de controle de [anterior.from, atual.to]
// (rawDeliveredItems com kind "control"); `itemIds` inclui os itens sem linha.
export function oracleControls(input: {
  lines: readonly RawDeliveredItem[];
  itemIds: readonly string[];
  period: DateRange;
  previous: DateRange;
}): OracleControlItem[] {
  return input.itemIds.map((itemId) => {
    const own = input.lines.filter((line) => line.itemId === itemId);
    const current = own.filter((line) =>
      inRange(line.operationalDate, input.period),
    );
    const before = own.filter((line) =>
      inRange(line.operationalDate, input.previous),
    );
    const sum = (lines: readonly RawDeliveredItem[]) =>
      lines.reduce((acc, line) => acc + line.quantity, 0);
    const total = sum(current);
    const byShift: OracleControlItem["byShift"] = {};
    for (const line of own) {
      const entry = byShift[line.shiftId] ?? { total: 0, previousTotal: 0 };
      if (inRange(line.operationalDate, input.period)) {
        entry.total += line.quantity;
      }
      if (inRange(line.operationalDate, input.previous)) {
        entry.previousTotal += line.quantity;
      }
      byShift[line.shiftId] = entry;
    }
    const byDay: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const line of own) {
      byDay[line.operationalDate] =
        (byDay[line.operationalDate] ?? 0) + line.quantity;
    }
    return {
      itemId,
      total,
      previousTotal: sum(before),
      handoverCount: current.length,
      average:
        current.length === 0
          ? null
          : Math.round((total / current.length) * 10) / 10,
      byShift,
      byDay,
    };
  });
}

export type OracleStockItem = {
  itemId: string;
  last: {
    quantity: number;
    operationalDate: string;
    shiftId: string;
    handoverId: string;
  } | null;
  lastBeforePeriod: boolean;
  points: { date: string; quantity: number | null }[];
};

// Estoque: `lines` são as contagens de estoque até o fim do período
// (rawDeliveredItems com kind "stock" e `to` = fim do período).
export function oracleStock(input: {
  lines: readonly RawDeliveredItem[];
  handovers: readonly RawHandover[];
  shifts: readonly RawShift[];
  itemIds: readonly string[];
  period: DateRange;
}): OracleStockItem[] {
  const endKey = (line: RawDeliveredItem): string => {
    const shift = input.shifts.find((s) => s.id === line.shiftId);
    if (!shift) throw new Error("oráculo: turno desconhecido");
    const end = shiftEnd(line.operationalDate, shift);
    return `${end.date}T${String(end.minutes).padStart(4, "0")}`;
  };
  const deliveredAt = (line: RawDeliveredItem): number =>
    input.handovers
      .find((h) => h.id === line.handoverId)
      ?.deliveredAt?.getTime() ?? 0;
  // Do mais recente para o mais antigo: dia, fim do turno, entrega, id.
  const newestFirst = (a: RawDeliveredItem, b: RawDeliveredItem): number => {
    if (a.operationalDate !== b.operationalDate) {
      return a.operationalDate < b.operationalDate ? 1 : -1;
    }
    const endA = endKey(a);
    const endB = endKey(b);
    if (endA !== endB) return endA < endB ? 1 : -1;
    if (deliveredAt(a) !== deliveredAt(b)) {
      return deliveredAt(a) < deliveredAt(b) ? 1 : -1;
    }
    return a.handoverId < b.handoverId
      ? 1
      : a.handoverId > b.handoverId
        ? -1
        : 0;
  };

  return input.itemIds.map((itemId) => {
    const own = input.lines
      .filter(
        (line) =>
          line.itemId === itemId && line.operationalDate <= input.period.to,
      )
      .sort(newestFirst);
    const newest = own[0];
    return {
      itemId,
      last: newest
        ? {
            quantity: newest.quantity,
            operationalDate: newest.operationalDate,
            shiftId: newest.shiftId,
            handoverId: newest.handoverId,
          }
        : null,
      lastBeforePeriod: newest
        ? newest.operationalDate < input.period.from
        : false,
      points: daysOf(input.period).map((date) => ({
        date,
        quantity:
          own.find((line) => line.operationalDate === date)?.quantity ?? null,
      })),
    };
  });
}

export type OracleRequests = {
  open: number;
  stale: number;
  deliveredInPeriod: number;
  destinations: Record<
    string,
    { deliveredCount: number; averageSeconds: number }
  >;
  items: Record<string, { quantity: number; requestCount: number }>;
};

const STALE_MS = 72 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

// Solicitações: a 1ª entrega é o menor `changedAt` com toStatus "delivered",
// calculado aqui sobre os eventos crus; o dia é o de São Paulo.
export function oracleRequests(input: {
  requests: readonly RawRequest[];
  now: Date;
  period: DateRange;
}): OracleRequests {
  let open = 0;
  let stale = 0;
  let deliveredInPeriod = 0;
  const groups = new Map<string, { count: number; seconds: number }>();
  const items: OracleRequests["items"] = {};

  for (const r of input.requests) {
    if (r.status === "requested" || r.status === "in_transit") {
      open += 1;
      const lastEvent = r.events.at(-1);
      const changedAt = lastEvent?.changedAt ?? r.createdAt;
      if (input.now.getTime() - changedAt.getTime() > STALE_MS) stale += 1;
    }

    const deliveries = r.events
      .filter((event) => event.toStatus === "delivered")
      .map((event) => event.changedAt.getTime());
    if (deliveries.length > 0) {
      const first = Math.min(...deliveries);
      if (inRange(saoPauloParts(new Date(first)).date, input.period)) {
        deliveredInPeriod += 1;
        const key = r.destinationId ?? "outro";
        const group = groups.get(key) ?? { count: 0, seconds: 0 };
        group.count += 1;
        group.seconds += (first - r.createdAt.getTime()) / 1000;
        groups.set(key, group);
      }
    }

    if (
      r.status !== "cancelled" &&
      inRange(saoPauloParts(r.createdAt).date, input.period)
    ) {
      for (const line of r.items) {
        const entry = items[line.itemId] ?? { quantity: 0, requestCount: 0 };
        entry.quantity += line.quantity;
        entry.requestCount += 1;
        items[line.itemId] = entry;
      }
    }
  }

  const destinations: OracleRequests["destinations"] = {};
  for (const [key, group] of groups) {
    destinations[key] = {
      deliveredCount: group.count,
      averageSeconds: group.seconds / group.count,
    };
  }
  return { open, stale, deliveredInPeriod, destinations, items };
}

export type OracleCsv = {
  rows: number;
  controlItemIds: string[];
  stockItemIds: string[];
  controlSums: Record<string, number>;
};

// CSV: uma linha por linha do histórico (= entregues + sem passagem), uma
// coluna por item que tem linha numa passagem entregue do período.
export function oracleCsv(input: {
  passages: PassagesData;
  controlLines: readonly RawDeliveredItem[];
  stockLines: readonly RawDeliveredItem[];
}): OracleCsv {
  const ids = (lines: readonly RawDeliveredItem[]) =>
    [...new Set(lines.map((line) => line.itemId))].sort();
  const controlSums: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const line of input.controlLines) {
    controlSums[line.itemId] = (controlSums[line.itemId] ?? 0) + line.quantity;
  }
  return {
    rows: input.passages.listed,
    controlItemIds: ids(input.controlLines),
    stockItemIds: ids(input.stockLines),
    controlSums,
  };
}

// Slot da cor do turno: posição entre TODOS os turnos do setor (ativos
// primeiro, depois sort_order, created_at, id); 1–4 têm cor própria.
export function oracleSlotOf(
  shifts: readonly RawShift[],
  sectorId: string,
  shiftId: string,
): SegmentSlot {
  const ordered = shifts
    .filter((s) => s.sectorId === sectorId)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.active !== b.active) return a.active ? -1 : 1;
      if (a.sortOrder !== b.sortOrder) return a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder;
      if (a.createdAt.getTime() !== b.createdAt.getTime()) {
        return a.createdAt.getTime() - b.createdAt.getTime();
      }
      return a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1;
    });
  const position = ordered.findIndex((s) => s.id === shiftId) + 1;
  if (position === 1) return 1;
  if (position === 2) return 2;
  if (position === 3) return 3;
  if (position === 4) return 4;
  return null;
}
```

```ts
  readRememberedSector: mocks.readRememberedSector,
}));

// 21/11/2026 14:30 em São Paulo.
const NOW = spDate("2026-11-21", "14:30");
const ADMIN = authzOf({ role: "admin" });

let client: PGlite;
let db: TestDb;

beforeAll(async () => {
  ({ client, db } = await createTestDb());
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await client.close();
});

beforeEach(async () => {
  await resetDb(client);
  mocks.readRememberedSector.mockReset();
  mocks.readRememberedSector.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
});

async function twoSectors() {
  const alfa = await insertSector(db, "Alfa Teste");
  const beta = await insertSector(db, "Beta Teste");
  return { alfa, beta };
}

async function scopeOf(
  actor: Authz,
  params: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> = {},
  now: Date = NOW,
) {
  const result = await resolveDashboardScope(db, actor, params, now);
  if (result.kind !== "ok") throw new Error(`escopo: ${result.kind}`);
  return result;
}

describe("resolveDashboardScope: setor", () => {
  it("admin sem nenhum setor ativo: none", async () => {
    const dormant = await insertSector(db, "Setor Dormente");
    await deactivateSector(db, dormant.id);
    await expect(resolveDashboardScope(db, ADMIN, {}, NOW)).resolves.toEqual({
      kind: "none",
    });
  });

  it("admin sem ?setor= e sem cookie: o primeiro setor ativo, nunca 'Todos'", async () => {
    const { alfa, beta } = await twoSectors();
    const { scope, sectors } = await scopeOf(ADMIN);
    expect(scope).toMatchObject({
      sectorId: alfa.id,
      sectorName: "Alfa Teste",
      sectorParam: alfa.id,
      showSector: false,
    });
    expect(sectors.map((sector) => sector.id)).toEqual([alfa.id, beta.id]);
  });

  it("admin com ?setor=<id>: esse setor", async () => {
    const { beta } = await twoSectors();
    const { scope } = await scopeOf(ADMIN, { setor: beta.id });
    expect(scope).toMatchObject({
      sectorId: beta.id,
      sectorName: "Beta Teste",
      sectorParam: beta.id,
      showSector: false,
    });
  });

  it("admin com ?setor=todos: sem setor, sem nome, com showSector", async () => {
    await twoSectors();
    const { scope } = await scopeOf(ADMIN, { setor: "todos" });
    expect(scope).toMatchObject({
      sectorId: null,
      sectorName: null,
      sectorParam: "todos",
      showSector: true,
    });
  });

  it("admin: o cookie vale quando a URL não escolhe, e a URL vence o cookie", async () => {
    const { alfa, beta } = await twoSectors();
    mocks.readRememberedSector.mockResolvedValue(beta.id);
    expect((await scopeOf(ADMIN)).scope.sectorId).toBe(beta.id);
    expect((await scopeOf(ADMIN, { setor: alfa.id })).scope.sectorId).toBe(
      alfa.id,
    );
  });

  it("admin: ?setor= inativo, inexistente ou lixo cai no cookie e depois no primeiro", async () => {
    const { alfa, beta } = await twoSectors();
    const dormant = await insertSector(db, "Dormente");
    await deactivateSector(db, dormant.id);
    for (const setor of [dormant.id, "nao-existe", "", "TODOS"]) {
      expect((await scopeOf(ADMIN, { setor })).scope.sectorId).toBe(alfa.id);
    }
    mocks.readRememberedSector.mockResolvedValue(beta.id);
    expect((await scopeOf(ADMIN, { setor: dormant.id })).scope.sectorId).toBe(
      beta.id,
    );
  });

  it("operador: o próprio setor, sem seletor, e nunca lê o cookie", async () => {
    const { alfa } = await twoSectors();
    const ana = await insertUser(db, {
      role: "operator",
      sectorId: alfa.id,
      name: "Ana Teste",
    });
    const actor = authzOf({
      role: "operator",
      userId: ana.id,
      sectorId: alfa.id,
    });
    const { scope, sectors } = await scopeOf(actor);
    expect(scope).toMatchObject({
      sectorId: alfa.id,
      sectorName: "Alfa Teste",
      sectorParam: null,
      showSector: false,
    });
    expect(sectors).toEqual([]);
    expect(mocks.readRememberedSector).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("operador com ?setor= de outro setor (ou 'todos'): continua no próprio", async () => {
    const { alfa, beta } = await twoSectors();
    const actor = authzOf({ role: "operator", sectorId: alfa.id });
    for (const setor of [beta.id, "todos"]) {
      const { scope } = await scopeOf(actor, { setor });
      expect(scope.sectorId).toBe(alfa.id);
      expect(scope.sectorParam).toBeNull();
      expect(scope.showSector).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("operador de setor inativo, ou de setor que não existe: inactive", async () => {
    const { alfa } = await twoSectors();
    await deactivateSector(db, alfa.id);
    await expect(
      resolveDashboardScope(
        db,
        authzOf({ role: "operator", sectorId: alfa.id }),
        {},
        NOW,
      ),
    ).resolves.toEqual({ kind: "inactive" });
    await expect(
      resolveDashboardScope(
        db,
        authzOf({
          role: "operator",
          sectorId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000ff",
        }),
        {},
        NOW,
      ),
    ).resolves.toEqual({ kind: "inactive" });
  });
});

describe("resolveDashboardScope: período", () => {
  it("padrão: últimos 7 dias, período anterior de 7 dias, today em São Paulo", async () => {
    await twoSectors();
    const { scope } = await scopeOf(ADMIN);
    expect(scope.period).toEqual({
      period: "7",
      from: "2026-11-15",
      to: "2026-11-21",
    });
    expect(scope.previous).toEqual({ from: "2026-11-08", to: "2026-11-14" });
    expect(scope.days).toBe(7);
    expect(scope.today).toBe("2026-11-21");
  });

  it("periodo=30: 30 dias e o anterior com 30 dias", async () => {
    await twoSectors();
    const { scope } = await scopeOf(ADMIN, { periodo: "30" });
    expect(scope.period).toEqual({
      period: "30",
      from: "2026-10-23",
      to: "2026-11-21",
    });
    expect(scope.previous).toEqual({ from: "2026-09-23", to: "2026-10-22" });
    expect(scope.days).toBe(30);
  });

  it("intervalo válido, de um dia e invertido", async () => {
    await twoSectors();
    const range = await scopeOf(ADMIN, {
      periodo: "intervalo",
      de: "2026-11-10",
      ate: "2026-11-14",
    });
    expect(range.scope.period).toEqual({
      period: "range",
      from: "2026-11-10",
      to: "2026-11-14",
    });
    expect(range.scope.days).toBe(5);
    expect(range.scope.previous).toEqual({
      from: "2026-11-05",
      to: "2026-11-09",
    });

    const oneDay = await scopeOf(ADMIN, {
      periodo: "intervalo",
      de: "2026-11-10",
      ate: "2026-11-10",
    });
    expect(oneDay.scope.days).toBe(1);
    expect(oneDay.scope.previous).toEqual({
      from: "2026-11-09",
      to: "2026-11-09",
    });

    const swapped = await scopeOf(ADMIN, {
      periodo: "intervalo",
      de: "2026-11-14",
      ate: "2026-11-10",
    });
    expect(swapped.scope.period).toMatchObject({
      from: "2026-11-10",
      to: "2026-11-14",
    });
  });

  it("intervalo de 94 dias é encurtado para 93 (de = ate − 92)", async () => {
    await twoSectors();
    const { scope } = await scopeOf(ADMIN, {
      periodo: "intervalo",
      de: "2026-08-19",
      ate: "2026-11-20",
    });
    expect(scope.period).toEqual({
      period: "range",
      from: "2026-08-20",
      to: "2026-11-20",
    });
    expect(scope.days).toBe(93);
    expect(scope.previous).toEqual({ from: "2026-05-19", to: "2026-08-19" });
  });

  it("intervalo no futuro, lixo e data irreal caem nos últimos 7 dias", async () => {
    await twoSectors();
    for (const params of [
      { periodo: "intervalo", de: "2026-12-01", ate: "2026-12-10" },
      { periodo: "intervalo", de: "2026-02-30", ate: "2026-11-10" },
      { periodo: "intervalo" },
      { periodo: "xyz" },
    ]) {
      const { scope } = await scopeOf(ADMIN, params);
      expect(scope.period.period).toBe("7");
      expect(scope.days).toBe(7);
    }
  });

  it("'hoje' é o dia de São Paulo: 23:30 ainda é o dia anterior, 00:00 já é o novo", async () => {
    await twoSectors();
    const lateNight = spDate("2026-11-20", "23:30");
    const midnight = spDate("2026-11-21", "00:00");
    expect((await scopeOf(ADMIN, {}, lateNight)).scope.today).toBe(
      "2026-11-20",
    );
    expect((await scopeOf(ADMIN, {}, midnight)).scope.today).toBe("2026-11-21");
    expect((await scopeOf(ADMIN, {}, midnight)).scope.period.to).toBe(
      "2026-11-21",
    );
  });
});
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import type { SectorChoice } from "@/features/admin/sectors";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { parseHistoryPeriod } from "@/features/handovers/historyFilters";
import { todayInSaoPaulo } from "@/features/handovers/saoPaulo";
import { resolveScreenSector } from "@/features/handovers/screenSector";
import type { SearchParams } from "@/lib/searchParams";

import { periodDays, previousPeriod } from "./period";
import type { DashboardScope } from "./types";

export type DashboardScopeResult =
  | { kind: "none" } // admin sem setor ativo
  | { kind: "inactive" } // operador de setor inativo
  | { kind: "ok"; scope: DashboardScope; sectors: readonly SectorChoice[] };

// A única resolução de setor e período do dashboard: a página e o CSV chamam
// esta função. O operador sempre vê o próprio setor (o ?setor= é ignorado).
export async function resolveDashboardScope(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  params: SearchParams,
  now: Date,
): Promise<DashboardScopeResult> {
  const screen = await resolveScreenSector(db, actor, {
    url: params.setor,
    allowAll: true,
  });
  if (screen.kind === "none") return { kind: "none" };
  if (screen.kind === "missing" || screen.kind === "inactive") {
    return { kind: "inactive" };
  }

  const today = todayInSaoPaulo(now);
  const period = parseHistoryPeriod(params, today);
  return {
    kind: "ok",
    sectors: screen.sectors,
    scope: {
      sectorId: screen.sectorId,
      sectorName: screen.sectorName,
      sectorParam: screen.sectorParam,
      showSector: screen.kind === "all",
      period,
      previous: previousPeriod(period),
      days: periodDays(period),
      today,
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import { type SQL, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { SectorScope } from "@/features/authz/sectorScope";
import { endsLocalSql } from "@/features/handovers/history";

// Fragmentos das consultas de passagem do dashboard. Aliases fixos: "h"
// (handover), "hi" (handover_item), "s" (shift), "sec" (sector).

// Setor ativo + escopo. O escopo "nothing" nunca chega aqui: quem chama
// responde vazio antes de montar a consulta.
export function handoverScopeSql(
  scope: Exclude<SectorScope, { kind: "nothing" }>,
): SQL {
  const wanted =
    scope.kind === "all" ? sql`true` : sql`h.sector_id = ${scope.sectorId}`;
  return sql`(sec.active and ${wanted})`;
}

// Passagem entregue: entregue ou confirmada.
export const DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL: SQL = sql`h.status in ('delivered', 'confirmed')`;

// Ordem cronológica real: dia, fim do turno, entrega, id (do mais recente).
export function chronologyOrderSql(): SQL {
  return sql`h.operational_date desc, ${endsLocalSql(sql`h.operational_date`)} desc, h.delivered_at desc, h.id desc`;
}
```

```ts
      logger: { logQuery: (text) => void logged.push(text) },
    });
    logged.length = 0;
    await getPassagesData(logging, ADMIN, worldQuery(world.uld.id), world.now);
    expect(logged).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 16: Write minimal implementation de `getPassagesData`**

Crie `src/features/dashboard/passages.ts` (uma consulta só, sobre a mesma `historySource` da lista de `/passagens`):

```ts
import "server-only";

import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { sectorScopeOf } from "@/features/authz/sectorScope";
import { historySource } from "@/features/handovers/history";

import type { DashboardQuery, PassagesData } from "./types";

const EMPTY: PassagesData = {
  expected: 0,
  delivered: 0,
  confirmed: 0,
  awaiting: 0,
  unconfirmed: 0,
  missing: 0,
  listed: 0,
};

// Uma consulta só sobre a mesma fonte da lista de /passagens: os números
// nunca divergem do que o link abre.
export async function getPassagesData(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: DashboardQuery,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PassagesData> {
  const scope = sectorScopeOf(actor, input.sectorId);
  if (scope.kind === "nothing") return EMPTY;

  const source = historySource(
    { ...input.period, shiftId: null },
    scope.kind === "sector" ? scope.sectorId : null,
    now,
  );
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      expected: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where u.expected)`.mapWith(Number),
      delivered:
        sql<number>`count(*) filter (where u.situation <> 'missing')`.mapWith(
          Number,
        ),
      confirmed:
        sql<number>`count(*) filter (where u.situation = 'confirmed')`.mapWith(
          Number,
        ),
      awaiting:
        sql<number>`count(*) filter (where u.situation = 'awaiting')`.mapWith(
          Number,
        ),
      unconfirmed:
        sql<number>`count(*) filter (where u.situation = 'unconfirmed')`.mapWith(
          Number,
        ),
      missing:
        sql<number>`count(*) filter (where u.situation = 'missing')`.mapWith(
          Number,
        ),
      listed: sql<number>`count(*)`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(source);
  return row ?? EMPTY;
}
```

Nenhum componente de UI: `ui-registry.md` não muda.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `chronologyOrderSql()`, `DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL`, `handoverScopeSql(scope)` (`features/dashboard/sql.ts`, Tarefa 7); `sectorScopeOf` (Tarefa 2); `DASHBOARD_ITEM_LIMIT` e `SEGMENT_SLOTS` (`features/dashboard/limits.ts`, Tarefa 4); `ControlsData`, `ControlItemMetric`, `ControlSegment`, `SeriesPoint`, `SegmentSlot`, `StockData`, `StockItemMetric`, `StockPoint`, `DashboardQuery` (`features/dashboard/types.ts`, Tarefa 4)
  - `seedDashboardWorld`, `rawShifts`, `rawHandovers`, `rawDeliveredItems`, `oracleControls`, `oracleStock`, `oracleSlotOf` (`test/dashboardWorld.ts`, Tarefa 7)
  - `passagesListHref`, `linkExtras`, `lastCountHref` (`features/dashboard/links.ts`, Tarefa 6); `listHistoryItems(db, sectorId, selectedItemId)` e `listHistoryShifts(db, sectorId, selectedShiftId)` (`features/handovers/historyChoices.ts`, Tarefa 6); `listHandoverHistory` com `itemId` (Tarefa 6)

Regras fixadas aqui (decisões de execução do contrato):
- **Controles: no máximo 3 consultas** (itens e totais numa passada; segmentos; série dos itens mostrados, só depois do `LIMIT`), todas agregadas no SQL: `sum(...) filter (where ...)`, `count(*) over ()` para `totalItems` e `array_agg(... order by slot)` para `parts`. O `total` do dia é `sum(quantity)::int` do SQL. `average` é `round(total::numeric / nullif(handoverCount, 0), 1)::float8` (`null` sem passagens; o `.mapWith(Number)` do Drizzle deixa `null` como `null`).
- **Estoque: 2 consultas** (itens com a última contagem por `DISTINCT ON (hi.item_id)` na ordem de `chronologyOrderSql()`; pontos por `DISTINCT ON (hi.item_id, h.operational_date)` com `generate_series` e `null` nos dias sem contagem).
- Um item de um setor **sem nenhum turno** aparece com `segments: []` e `series: []` (sem turno não há passagem; o cartão cai no estado vazio `Sem passagens no período`).

```ts
      [s.retired, "Turno Antigo", 4, 2, 0],
    ]);
    expect(shape(world.items.oldStrap)).toEqual([
      [s.morning, "Manhã", 1, 2, 0],
      [s.afternoon, "Tarde", 2, 0, 0],
      [s.night, "Noite", 3, 0, 0],
      [s.retired, "Turno Antigo", 4, 1, 0],
    ]);
    // Lacre ULD nunca teve linha: o Turno Antigo (inativo) não vira segmento.
    expect(shape(world.items.uldSeal)).toEqual([
      [s.morning, "Manhã", 1, 0, 0],
      [s.afternoon, "Tarde", 2, 0, 0],
      [s.night, "Noite", 3, 0, 0],
    ]);
    // Nenhum agregado: Σ dos segmentos = total e Σ dos anteriores = anterior.
    for (const metric of data.items) {
      const sum = (pick: (seg: (typeof metric.segments)[number]) => number) =>
        metric.segments.reduce((acc, seg) => acc + pick(seg), 0);
      expect(
        sum((seg) => seg.total),
        metric.name,
      ).toBe(metric.total);
      expect(
        sum((seg) => seg.previousTotal),
        metric.name,
      ).toBe(metric.previousTotal);
    }
  });

  it("série: 2N dias contíguos, zeros do SQL, total do dia = soma das partes, Σ dos N últimos = total", async () => {
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(world.uld.id));
    const net = metricOf(data.items, world.items.net);
    expect(net.series).toHaveLength(14);
    expect(net.series.map((point) => point.date)).toEqual(
      Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, index) =>
        addDays(world.previous.from, index),
      ),
    );
    expect(net.series.map((point) => point.total)).toEqual([
      0, 0, 0, 4, 0, 2, 0, 5, 5, 5, 8, 0, 3, 9,
    ]);
    for (const point of net.series) {
      expect(point.parts).toHaveLength(net.segments.length);
      expect(point.parts.reduce((acc, part) => acc + part, 0)).toBe(
        point.total,
      );
    }
    // 17/11 (a Tarde corrigida de 5 para 8): Tarde = 8, o resto 0.
    expect(net.series[10]?.parts).toEqual([0, 8, 0, 0]);
    expect(
      net.series.slice(7).reduce((acc, point) => acc + point.total, 0),
    ).toBe(net.total);
  });

  it("Câmara: Lacre com um segmento (Dia) e a variação do anterior", async () => {
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(world.camara.id));
    expect(data.totalItems).toBe(1);
    const seal = metricOf(data.items, world.items.seal);
    expect(seal).toMatchObject({
      name: "Lacre",
      total: 6,
      previousTotal: 5,
      handoverCount: 2,
      average: 3,
      sectorName: "Câmara Teste",
    });
    expect(seal.segments).toEqual([
      {
        key: world.shifts.camaraDay,
        shiftId: world.shifts.camaraDay,
        label: "Dia",
        slot: 1,
        total: 6,
        previousTotal: 5,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("'Todos os setores': Câmara primeiro, os 5 itens, sem o Setor Parado", async () => {
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(null));
    expect(data.totalItems).toBe(5);
    expect(data.items.map((metric) => metric.name)).toEqual([
      "Lacre",
      "Rede de proteção",
      "Cinta",
      "Cinta antiga",
      "Lacre ULD",
    ]);
    expect(data.items.map((metric) => metric.sectorName)).toEqual([
      "Câmara Teste",
      "ULD Teste",
      "ULD Teste",
      "ULD Teste",
      "ULD Teste",
    ]);
  });

  it("item ativo sem passagem (Lacre ULD) aparece vazio; item inativo com linha (Cinta antiga) também", async () => {
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(world.uld.id));
    expect(metricOf(data.items, world.items.uldSeal)).toMatchObject({
      total: 0,
      handoverCount: 0,
      average: null,
    });
    expect(metricOf(data.items, world.items.oldStrap).handoverCount).toBe(2);
  });

  it("período de 1 dia: série de 2 pontos (anterior e atual)", async () => {
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, {
      sectorId: world.uld.id,
      period: { from: "2026-11-17", to: "2026-11-17" },
      previous: { from: "2026-11-16", to: "2026-11-16" },
    });
    const net = metricOf(data.items, world.items.net);
    // O Turno Antigo (inativo) não tem linha de 16 e 17/11: não vira segmento.
    expect(net.total).toBe(8);
    expect(net.previousTotal).toBe(5);
    expect(net.series).toEqual([
      { date: "2026-11-16", total: 5, parts: [5, 0, 0] },
      { date: "2026-11-17", total: 8, parts: [0, 8, 0] },
    ]);
  });

  it("período anterior vazio: anterior 0 e o resto igual", async () => {
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, {
      sectorId: world.uld.id,
      period: { from: "2026-11-14", to: "2026-11-20" },
      previous: { from: "2026-10-01", to: "2026-10-07" },
    });
    const net = metricOf(data.items, world.items.net);
    expect(net.total).toBe(35);
    expect(net.previousTotal).toBe(0);
    expect(net.segments.every((seg) => seg.previousTotal === 0)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("operador com sectorId de outro setor no input: vê o próprio setor", async () => {
    const data = await getControlsData(
      db,
      world.people.cris,
      queryOf(world.uld.id),
    );
    expect(data.items.map((metric) => metric.name)).toEqual(["Lacre"]);
  });

  it("operador de setor inativo e operador sem setor: vazio", async () => {
    const empty = { items: [], totalItems: 0 };
    expect(
      await getControlsData(db, world.people.duda, queryOf(world.inactive.id)),
    ).toEqual(empty);
    expect(
      await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(world.inactive.id)),
    ).toEqual(empty);
    expect(
      await getControlsData(
        db,
        { ...world.people.ana, sectorId: null },
        queryOf(world.uld.id),
      ),
    ).toEqual(empty);
  });

  it("no máximo três consultas, nunca uma por item", async () => {
    const logged: string[] = [];
    const logging = drizzle(client, {
      schema,
      logger: { logQuery: (text) => void logged.push(text) },
    });
    await getControlsData(logging, ADMIN, queryOf(null));
    expect(logged.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3);
    expect(logged.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

describe("getControlsData em cenários próprios", () => {
  let client: PGlite;
  let db: TestDb;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    ({ client, db } = await createTestDb());
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await client.close();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await resetDb(client);
  });

  const query = (sectorId: string): DashboardQuery => ({
    sectorId,
    period: { from: "2026-11-14", to: "2026-11-20" },
    previous: { from: "2026-11-07", to: "2026-11-13" },
  });

  async function deliver(input: {
    sectorId: string;
    shiftId: string;
    by: string;
    date: string;
    lines: readonly (readonly [string, number])[];
  }) {
    const created = await insertHandover(db, {
      sectorId: input.sectorId,
      shiftId: input.shiftId,
      operationalDate: input.date,
      status: "delivered",
      deliveredBy: input.by,
      deliveredAt: spDate(input.date, "23:00"),
    });
    for (const [itemId, quantity] of input.lines) {
      await insertHandoverItem(db, {
        handoverId: created.id,
        itemId,
        quantity,
        snapshot: true,
      });
    }
    return created.id;
  }

  async function base() {
    const sector = await insertSector(db, "Setor Teste");
    const ana = await insertUser(db, {
      role: "operator",
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Ana Teste",
    });
    const net = await insertItem(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Rede de proteção",
      unit: "rede",
      sortOrder: 1,
    });
    return { sector, ana, net };
  }

  it("2 turnos inativos com sort_order menor: os 3 ativos ficam nos slots 1 a 3, os inativos com linha depois", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, net } = await base();
    const make = (name: string, sortOrder: number, active: boolean) =>
      insertShift(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        name,
        sortOrder,
        active,
        createdAt: OLD,
      });
    const retiredA = await make("Antigo A", 1, false);
    const retiredB = await make("Antigo B", 2, false);
    await make("Manhã", 5, true);
    await make("Tarde", 6, true);
    await make("Noite", 7, true);
    await deliver({
      sectorId: sector.id,
      shiftId: retiredA.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-15",
      lines: [[net.id, 4]],
    });
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id));
    expect(
      data.items[0]?.segments.map((seg) => [seg.label, seg.slot, seg.total]),
    ).toEqual([
      ["Manhã", 1, 0],
      ["Tarde", 2, 0],
      ["Noite", 3, 0],
      ["Antigo A", 4, 4],
    ]);
    // O Antigo B (slot 5) sem linha não vira segmento.
    expect(data.items[0]?.segments.map((seg) => seg.shiftId)).not.toContain(
      retiredB.id,
    );
  });

  it("5º turno ativo: slot null, com a própria linha, total e shiftId (nunca agregado)", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, net } = await base();
    const shifts = [];
    for (const [index, name] of [
      "Turno 1",
      "Turno 2",
      "Turno 3",
      "Turno 4",
      "Turno 5",
    ].entries()) {
      shifts.push(
        await insertShift(db, {
          sectorId: sector.id,
          name,
          sortOrder: index + 1,
          createdAt: OLD,
        }),
      );
    }
    for (const [index, turn] of shifts.entries()) {
      await deliver({
        sectorId: sector.id,
        shiftId: turn.id,
        by: ana.id,
        date: "2026-11-16",
        lines: [[net.id, index + 1]],
      });
    }
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id));
    const segments = data.items[0]?.segments ?? [];
    expect(segments.map((seg) => seg.slot)).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, null]);
    expect(segments[4]).toMatchObject({
      label: "Turno 5",
      shiftId: shifts[4]?.id,
      total: 5,
    });
    expect(segments.reduce((acc, seg) => acc + seg.total, 0)).toBe(15);
  });

  it("teto de 30 cartões: totalItems conta todos, a ordem é a do cadastro", async () => {
    const { sector } = await base();
    for (let n = 2; n <= 31; n += 1) {
      await insertItem(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        name: `Item ${String(n).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        sortOrder: n,
      });
    }
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id));
    expect(data.items).toHaveLength(30);
    expect(data.totalItems).toBe(31);
    expect(data.items[0]?.name).toBe("Rede de proteção");
    expect(data.items[29]?.name).toBe("Item 30");
  });

  it("soma no teto de quantidade (99.999 × linhas) sem estourar", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, net } = await base();
    const turn = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    for (const date of ["2026-11-15", "2026-11-16", "2026-11-17"]) {
      await deliver({
        sectorId: sector.id,
        shiftId: turn.id,
        by: ana.id,
        date,
        lines: [[net.id, 99_999]],
      });
    }
    const [metric] = (await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id))).items;
    expect(metric).toMatchObject({ total: 299_997, average: 99_999 });
    expect(metric?.series.map((point) => point.total)).toContain(99_999);
  });

  it("nome e unidade vêm do snapshot mais recente da janela; renomear o item depois não muda", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, net } = await base();
    const turn = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    await deliver({
      sectorId: sector.id,
      shiftId: turn.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-15",
      lines: [[net.id, 2]],
    });
    await db
      .update(item)
      .set({ name: "Rede nova", unit: "peça" })
      .where(eq(item.id, net.id));
    await deliver({
      sectorId: sector.id,
      shiftId: turn.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-16",
      lines: [[net.id, 3]],
    });
    await db
      .update(item)
      .set({ name: "Nome depois de tudo", unit: "caixa" })
      .where(eq(item.id, net.id));
    const [metric] = (await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id))).items;
    // Uma linha só (agrupa por item_id), com o snapshot da entrega mais recente.
    expect(metric).toMatchObject({
      name: "Rede nova",
      unit: "peça",
      total: 5,
    });
  });

  it("sem nenhuma passagem, o item mostra o nome do cadastro", async () => {
    const { sector } = await base();
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id));
    expect(data.items[0]).toMatchObject({
      name: "Rede de proteção",
      unit: "rede",
      total: 0,
      handoverCount: 0,
      average: null,
    });
  });

  it("setor sem turnos: o item aparece, sem segmentos e sem série", async () => {
    const { sector } = await base();
    const [metric] = (await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id))).items;
    expect(metric?.segments).toEqual([]);
    expect(metric?.series).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("item de estoque nunca entra em Controles; setor desativado depois some", async () => {
    const { sector } = await base();
    await insertItem(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Stretch",
      unit: "rolo",
      kind: "stock",
      sortOrder: 2,
    });
    const before = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id));
    expect(before.items.map((metric) => metric.name)).toEqual([
      "Rede de proteção",
    ]);
    await deactivateSector(db, sector.id);
    expect(await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id))).toEqual({
      items: [],
      totalItems: 0,
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
describe("getStockData em cenários próprios", () => {
  let client: PGlite;
  let db: TestDb;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    ({ client, db } = await createTestDb());
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await client.close();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await resetDb(client);
  });

    sectorId,
    period: { from: "2026-11-14", to: "2026-11-20" },
    previous: { from: "2026-11-07", to: "2026-11-13" },
  });

  async function base() {
    const sector = await insertSector(db, "Setor Teste");
    const ana = await insertUser(db, {
      role: "operator",
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Ana Teste",
    });
    const stretch = await insertItem(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Stretch",
      unit: "rolo",
      kind: "stock",
      sortOrder: 1,
    });
    return { sector, ana, stretch };
  }

  async function count(input: {
    sectorId: string;
    shiftId: string;
    by: string;
    date: string;
    deliveredAt: Date;
    itemId: string;
    quantity: number;
  }) {
    const created = await insertHandover(db, {
      sectorId: input.sectorId,
      shiftId: input.shiftId,
      operationalDate: input.date,
      status: "delivered",
      deliveredBy: input.by,
      deliveredAt: input.deliveredAt,
    });
    await insertHandoverItem(db, {
      handoverId: created.id,
      itemId: input.itemId,
      quantity: input.quantity,
      snapshot: true,
    });
    return created.id;
  }

  it("fim do turno igual no mesmo dia: vence a entrega mais recente", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, stretch } = await base();
    const first = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã A",
      startsAt: "06:00",
      endsAt: "14:00",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    const second = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã B",
      startsAt: "07:00",
      endsAt: "14:00",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    const common = {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-18",
      itemId: stretch.id,
    };
    await count({
      ...common,
      shiftId: first.id,
      deliveredAt: spDate("2026-11-18", "14:30"),
      quantity: 7,
    });
    await count({
      ...common,
      shiftId: second.id,
      deliveredAt: spDate("2026-11-18", "14:10"),
      quantity: 9,
    });
    const [metric] = (await getStockData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id))).items;
    expect(metric?.last?.quantity).toBe(7);
    expect(metric?.points.find((p) => p.date === "2026-11-18")?.quantity).toBe(
      7,
    );
  });

  it("entrega no mesmo instante: vence o maior id da passagem", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, stretch } = await base();
    const first = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã A",
      startsAt: "06:00",
      endsAt: "14:00",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    const second = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã B",
      startsAt: "07:00",
      endsAt: "14:00",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    const at = spDate("2026-11-18", "14:30");
    const common = {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-18",
      itemId: stretch.id,
      deliveredAt: at,
    };
    const idA = await count({ ...common, shiftId: first.id, quantity: 7 });
    const idB = await count({ ...common, shiftId: second.id, quantity: 9 });
    const [metric] = (await getStockData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id))).items;
    expect(metric?.last?.handoverId).toBe(idA > idB ? idA : idB);
  });

  it("item inativo com contagem no período aparece; só com contagem antes do período, não", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, stretch } = await base();
    const old = await insertItem(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Filme antigo",
      unit: "rolo",
      kind: "stock",
      sortOrder: 2,
      active: false,
    });
    const gone = await insertItem(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Fita antiga",
      unit: "rolo",
      kind: "stock",
      sortOrder: 3,
      active: false,
    });
    const turn = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    await count({
      sectorId: sector.id,
      shiftId: turn.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-16",
      deliveredAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "14:30"),
      itemId: old.id,
      quantity: 3,
    });
    await count({
      sectorId: sector.id,
      shiftId: turn.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-09",
      deliveredAt: spDate("2026-11-09", "14:30"),
      itemId: gone.id,
      quantity: 8,
    });
    const data = await getStockData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id));
    expect(data.items.map((metric) => metric.name)).toEqual([
      "Stretch",
      "Filme antigo",
    ]);
    expect(data.totalItems).toBe(2);
    expect(data.items[0]?.itemId).toBe(stretch.id);
  });

  it("nome e unidade vêm da última contagem; renomear o item depois não muda", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, stretch } = await base();
    const turn = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    await count({
      sectorId: sector.id,
      shiftId: turn.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-16",
      deliveredAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "14:30"),
      itemId: stretch.id,
      quantity: 3,
    });
    await db
      .update(item)
      .set({ name: "Depois de tudo", unit: "caixa" })
      .where(eq(item.id, stretch.id));
    const [metric] = (await getStockData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id))).items;
    expect(metric).toMatchObject({ name: "Stretch", unit: "rolo" });
    expect(metric?.last?.unit).toBe("rolo");
  });

  it("teto de 30 cartões: totalItems conta todos", async () => {
    const { sector } = await base();
    for (let n = 2; n <= 31; n += 1) {
      await insertItem(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        name: `Item ${String(n).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        kind: "stock",
        sortOrder: n,
      });
    }
    const data = await getStockData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id));
    expect(data.items).toHaveLength(30);
    expect(data.totalItems).toBe(31);
    expect(data.items.every((metric) => metric.points.length === 7)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("contagem de zero é uma contagem (0 ≠ sem contagem)", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, stretch } = await base();
    const turn = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Manhã",
      createdAt: OLD,
    });
    await count({
      sectorId: sector.id,
      shiftId: turn.id,
      by: ana.id,
      date: "2026-11-16",
      deliveredAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "14:30"),
      itemId: stretch.id,
      quantity: 0,
    });
    const [metric] = (await getStockData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id))).items;
    expect(metric?.last?.quantity).toBe(0);
    expect(metric?.points.find((p) => p.date === "2026-11-16")?.quantity).toBe(
      0,
    );
    expect(metric?.points.find((p) => p.date === "2026-11-17")?.quantity).toBe(
      null,
    );
  });
});
```

```ts
describe("Controles e Estoque", () => {
  const sectorIdsOf = (sectorId: string | null) =>
    sectorId === null ? [world.uld.id, world.camara.id] : [sectorId];

  async function controlsOracle(sectorId: string | null) {
    const sectorIds = sectorIdsOf(sectorId);
    const lines = await rawDeliveredItems(db, {
      sectorIds,
      range: { from: world.previous.from, to: world.period.to },
      kind: "control",
    });
    const shifts = await rawShifts(db, sectorIds);
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(sectorId));
    const metrics = oracleControls({
      lines,
      itemIds: data.items.map((metric) => metric.itemId),
      period: world.period,
      previous: world.previous,
    });
    return { data, metrics, lines, shifts };
  }

  const SCOPES: readonly [string, () => string | null][] = [
    ["ULD", () => world.uld.id],
    ["Câmara", () => world.camara.id],
    ["Todos os setores", () => null],
  ];

  it.each(
    SCOPES,
  )("Controles (%s): total, anterior, passagens, média e segmentos batem com o oráculo (valor vigente, depois da correção)", async (_name, sector) => {
    const { data, metrics, lines, shifts } = await controlsOracle(sector());
    expect(data.items.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const metric of data.items) {
      const expected = metrics.find((entry) => entry.itemId === metric.itemId);
      if (!expected) throw new Error("oráculo sem o item");
      expect(metric.total, metric.name).toBe(expected.total);
      expect(metric.previousTotal, metric.name).toBe(expected.previousTotal);
      expect(metric.handoverCount, metric.name).toBe(expected.handoverCount);
      expect(metric.average, metric.name).toBe(expected.average);

      // Um segmento por turno: os ativos do setor do item + o inativo com linha.
      const wanted = shifts
        .filter(
          (shift) =>
            shift.sectorId === metric.sectorId &&
            (shift.active || expected.byShift[shift.id] !== undefined),
        )
        .map((shift) => shift.id)
        .sort();
      expect(metric.segments.map((seg) => seg.shiftId).sort()).toEqual(wanted);
      for (const segment of metric.segments) {
        const part = expected.byShift[segment.shiftId] ?? {
          total: 0,
          previousTotal: 0,
        };
        expect(segment.total, `${metric.name} ${segment.label}`).toBe(
          part.total,
        );
        expect(segment.previousTotal, `${metric.name} ${segment.label}`).toBe(
          part.previousTotal,
        );
        expect(segment.slot).toBe(
          oracleSlotOf(shifts, metric.sectorId, segment.shiftId),
        );
      }

      // A série: 2N dias contíguos, o dia e cada parte batem com as linhas cruas.
      expect(metric.series).toHaveLength(2 * 7);
      for (const [index, point] of metric.series.entries()) {
        const day = addDays(world.previous.from, index);
        expect(point.date).toBe(day);
        expect(point.total, `${metric.name} ${day}`).toBe(
          expected.byDay[day] ?? 0,
        );
        expect(point.parts).toEqual(
          metric.segments.map((segment) =>
            lines
              .filter(
                (line) =>
                  line.itemId === metric.itemId &&
                  line.shiftId === segment.shiftId &&
                  line.operationalDate === day,
              )
              .reduce((acc, line) => acc + line.quantity, 0),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  });

  it("Controles: os literais da tabela do mundo (Rede 5 → 8 depois da correção vale 8)", async () => {
    const data = await getControlsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(null));
    const by = (itemId: string) => {
      const found = data.items.find((metric) => metric.itemId === itemId);
      if (!found) throw new Error("item fora do resultado");
      return found;
    };
    expect(
      [world.items.net, world.items.strap, world.items.oldStrap].map((id) => [
        by(id).total,
        by(id).previousTotal,
        by(id).handoverCount,
        by(id).average,
      ]),
    ).toEqual([
      [35, 6, 10, 3.5],
      [36, 9, 10, 3.6],
      [3, 0, 2, 1.5],
    ]);
    expect(by(world.items.seal)).toMatchObject({
      total: 6,
      previousTotal: 5,
      handoverCount: 2,
      average: 3,
    });
    expect(by(world.items.uldSeal)).toMatchObject({
      total: 0,
      handoverCount: 0,
      average: null,
    });
    const net = by(world.items.net);
    expect(net.series.map((point) => point.total)).toEqual([
      0, 0, 0, 4, 0, 2, 0, 5, 5, 5, 8, 0, 3, 9,
    ]);
    expect(
      net.series.slice(7).reduce((acc, point) => acc + point.total, 0),
    ).toBe(35);
  });

  it("Controles (C-1): o total, a legenda e cada segmento são o total da lista que o link abre, depois da mesma validação da tela", async () => {
    const { data, lines } = await controlsOracle(null);
    const current = lines.filter(
      (line) => line.operationalDate >= world.period.from,
    );
    for (const metric of data.items) {
      const extras = { ...linkExtras(metric.sectorId), itemId: metric.itemId };
      const totalHref = passagesListHref(world.period, "delivered", extras);
      const filters = parseHistoryFilters(
        queryRecord(hrefQuery(totalHref)),
        world.today,
      );
      // A tela só mantém o item que está nas escolhas do setor (inclusive o
      // inativo escolhido pela URL, como a Cinta antiga).
      const choices = await listHistoryItems(
        db,
        metric.sectorId,
        filters.itemId,
      );
      expect(
        choices.map((choice) => choice.id),
        metric.name,
      ).toContain(metric.itemId);
      const list = await listHandoverHistory(
        db,
        ADMIN,
        { filters, sectorId: metric.sectorId, page: 1 },
        world.now,
      );
      expect(list.total, metric.name).toBe(metric.handoverCount);

      for (const segment of metric.segments) {
        const href = passagesListHref(world.period, "delivered", {
          ...extras,
          shiftId: segment.shiftId,
        });
        const segFilters = parseHistoryFilters(
          queryRecord(hrefQuery(href)),
          world.today,
        );
        const shiftChoices = await listHistoryShifts(
          db,
          metric.sectorId,
          segFilters.shiftId,
        );
        expect(shiftChoices.map((choice) => choice.id)).toContain(
          segment.shiftId,
        );
        const segList = await listHandoverHistory(
          db,
          ADMIN,
          { filters: segFilters, sectorId: metric.sectorId, page: 1 },
          world.now,
        );
        // As passagens do item naquele turno (uma linha por passagem).
        expect(segList.total, `${metric.name} ${segment.label}`).toBe(
          current.filter(
            (line) =>
              line.itemId === metric.itemId && line.shiftId === segment.shiftId,
          ).length,
        );
      }
    }
  });

  it.each(
    SCOPES,
  )("Estoque (%s): a última contagem e os pontos batem com o oráculo, na ordem cronológica", async (_name, sector) => {
    const sectorId = sector();
    const sectorIds = sectorIdsOf(sectorId);
    const data = await getStockData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(sectorId));
    const metrics = oracleStock({
      lines: await rawDeliveredItems(db, {
        sectorIds,
        range: { from: "2026-01-01", to: world.period.to },
        kind: "stock",
      }),
      handovers: await rawHandovers(db, sectorIds),
      shifts: await rawShifts(db, sectorIds),
      itemIds: data.items.map((metric) => metric.itemId),
      period: world.period,
    });
    const shifts = await rawShifts(db, sectorIds);
    expect(data.items.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const metric of data.items) {
      const expected = metrics.find((entry) => entry.itemId === metric.itemId);
      if (!expected) throw new Error("oráculo sem o item");
      expect(metric.last?.quantity ?? null, metric.name).toBe(
        expected.last?.quantity ?? null,
      );
      expect(metric.last?.operationalDate ?? null, metric.name).toBe(
        expected.last?.operationalDate ?? null,
      );
      expect(metric.last?.handoverId ?? null, metric.name).toBe(
        expected.last?.handoverId ?? null,
      );
      expect(metric.last?.shiftName ?? null, metric.name).toBe(
        shifts.find((shift) => shift.id === expected.last?.shiftId)?.name ??
          null,
      );
      expect(metric.lastBeforePeriod, metric.name).toBe(
        expected.lastBeforePeriod,
      );
      expect(metric.points, metric.name).toEqual(expected.points);
    }
  });

  it("Estoque: os literais do mundo e o link da última contagem abre a passagem", async () => {
    const data = await getStockData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(world.uld.id));
    const stretch = data.items.find(
      (metric) => metric.itemId === world.items.stretch,
    );
    expect(stretch?.last).toMatchObject({
      quantity: 12,
      operationalDate: "2026-11-20",
      shiftName: "Tarde",
    });
    expect(stretch?.points.map((point) => point.quantity)).toEqual([
      9,
      7,
      6,
      5,
      null,
      3,
      12,
    ]);
    expect(lastCountHref(stretch?.last?.handoverId ?? "")).toBe(
      `/passagens/${world.handovers["20T"]}`,
    );
    const film = data.items.find(
      (metric) => metric.itemId === world.items.film,
    );
    expect(film?.last).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write minimal implementation de `getControlsData`**

Crie `src/features/dashboard/controls.ts`:

```ts
import "server-only";

import { type SQL, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { sectorScopeOf } from "@/features/authz/sectorScope";

import { DASHBOARD_ITEM_LIMIT, SEGMENT_SLOTS } from "./limits";
import {
  chronologyOrderSql,
  DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL,
  handoverScopeSql,
} from "./sql";
import type {
  ControlItemMetric,
  ControlSegment,
  ControlsData,
  DashboardQuery,
  SegmentSlot,
  SeriesPoint,
} from "./types";

const EMPTY: ControlsData = { items: [], totalItems: 0 };

// 1–4 têm cor própria; do 5º turno em diante a cor é a neutra (slot null),
// mas o turno continua sendo um segmento com a própria linha.
function toSlot(position: number): SegmentSlot {
  if (position > SEGMENT_SLOTS) return null;
  switch (position) {
    case 1:
      return 1;
    case 2:
      return 2;
    case 3:
      return 3;
    case 4:
      return 4;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

function inRange(column: string, from: string, to: string): SQL {
  return sql`${sql.raw(column)} between ${from}::date and ${to}::date`;
}

/**
 * Itens de controle do período: total, anterior, passagens com o item, média
 * por turno, um segmento por turno e a série diária de 2N dias. No máximo três
 * consultas (itens e totais; segmentos; série dos itens mostrados), todas
 * agregadas no SQL: nada é somado aqui.
 */
export async function getControlsData(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: DashboardQuery,
): Promise<ControlsData> {
  const scope = sectorScopeOf(actor, input.sectorId);
  if (scope.kind === "nothing") return EMPTY;
  const { period, previous } = input;

  const itemScope =
    scope.kind === "all" ? sql`true` : sql`i.sector_id = ${scope.sectorId}`;
  const current = inRange("operational_date", period.from, period.to);
  const before = inRange("operational_date", previous.from, previous.to);

  // 1. Itens (ativos do escopo ∪ com linha na janela) e os totais, numa passada.
  const items = await db
    .select({
      itemId: sql<string>`c.item_id`,
      sectorId: sql<string>`c.sector_id`,
      sectorName: sql<string>`c.sector_name`,
      name: sql<string>`c.name`,
      unit: sql<string>`c.unit`,
      total: sql<number>`c.total`.mapWith(Number),
      previousTotal: sql<number>`c.previous_total`.mapWith(Number),
      handoverCount: sql<number>`c.handover_count`.mapWith(Number),
      average: sql<number | null>`c.average`.mapWith(Number),
      totalItems: sql<number>`c.total_items`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(
      sql`(
        with lines as (
          select hi.item_id, hi.quantity, hi.item_name_snapshot, hi.item_unit_snapshot,
            h.operational_date,
            row_number() over (partition by hi.item_id order by ${chronologyOrderSql()}) as rn
          from handover_item hi
          join handover h on h.id = hi.handover_id
          join shift s on s.id = h.shift_id
          join sector sec on sec.id = h.sector_id
          where hi.item_kind_snapshot = 'control' and ${DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL}
            and h.operational_date between ${previous.from}::date and ${period.to}::date
            and ${handoverScopeSql(scope)}
        ),
        totals as (
          select item_id,
            sum(quantity) filter (where ${current}) as total,
            sum(quantity) filter (where ${before}) as previous_total,
            count(*) filter (where ${current}) as handover_count,
            max(item_name_snapshot) filter (where rn = 1) as name,
            max(item_unit_snapshot) filter (where rn = 1) as unit
          from lines
          group by item_id
        )
        select i.id as item_id, i.sector_id, sec.name as sector_name,
          coalesce(t.name, i.name) as name, coalesce(t.unit, i.unit) as unit,
          coalesce(t.total, 0) as total,
          coalesce(t.previous_total, 0) as previous_total,
          coalesce(t.handover_count, 0) as handover_count,
          round(t.total::numeric / nullif(t.handover_count, 0), 1)::float8 as average,
          count(*) over () as total_items,
          row_number() over (order by lower(sec.name), i.sort_order, i.id) as ord
        from item i
        join sector sec on sec.id = i.sector_id
        left join totals t on t.item_id = i.id
        where sec.active and ${itemScope}
          and ((i.active and i.kind = 'control') or t.item_id is not null)
        order by ord
        limit ${DASHBOARD_ITEM_LIMIT}
      ) as c`,
    )
    .orderBy(sql`c.ord`);
  if (items.length === 0) return EMPTY;

  const idList = sql.join(
    items.map((row) => sql`${row.itemId}::uuid`),
    sql`, `,
  );

  // 2. Um segmento por turno: os ativos do setor do item ∪ os inativos com
  //    linha do item na janela; slot = posição entre TODOS os turnos do setor.
  const segmentRows = await db
    .select({
      itemId: sql<string>`c.item_id`,
      shiftId: sql<string>`c.shift_id`,
      label: sql<string>`c.label`,
      slot: sql<number>`c.slot`.mapWith(Number),
      total: sql<number>`c.total`.mapWith(Number),
      previousTotal: sql<number>`c.previous_total`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(
      sql`(
        with ranked as (
          select s.id as shift_id, s.name, s.sector_id, s.active,
            row_number() over (
              partition by s.sector_id order by s.active desc, s.sort_order, s.created_at, s.id
            ) as slot
          from shift s
          where s.sector_id in (select sector_id from item where id in (${idList}))
        ),
        sums as (
          select hi.item_id, h.shift_id,
            sum(hi.quantity) filter (where ${current}) as total,
            sum(hi.quantity) filter (where ${before}) as previous_total
          from handover_item hi
          join handover h on h.id = hi.handover_id
          where hi.item_id in (${idList}) and hi.item_kind_snapshot = 'control'
            and ${DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL}
            and h.operational_date between ${previous.from}::date and ${period.to}::date
          group by hi.item_id, h.shift_id
        )
        select i.id as item_id, r.shift_id, r.name as label, r.slot,
          coalesce(m.total, 0) as total,
          coalesce(m.previous_total, 0) as previous_total
        from item i
        join ranked r on r.sector_id = i.sector_id
        left join sums m on m.item_id = i.id and m.shift_id = r.shift_id
        where i.id in (${idList}) and (r.active or m.shift_id is not null)
      ) as c`,
    )
    .orderBy(sql`c.item_id`, sql`c.slot`);

  const segmentsOf = new Map<string, ControlSegment[]>();
  const pairs: SQL[] = [];
  for (const row of segmentRows) {
    const list = segmentsOf.get(row.itemId) ?? [];
    list.push({
      key: row.shiftId,
      shiftId: row.shiftId,
      label: row.label,
      slot: toSlot(row.slot),
      total: row.total,
      previousTotal: row.previousTotal,
    });
    segmentsOf.set(row.itemId, list);
    pairs.push(
      sql`(${row.itemId}::uuid, ${row.shiftId}::uuid, ${row.slot}::int)`,
    );
  }

  // 3. A série dos itens mostrados: um ponto por dia de [anterior, atual] (2N),
  //    com os zeros e o total do dia somados no SQL; `parts` na ordem dos segmentos.
  const seriesOf = new Map<string, SeriesPoint[]>();
  if (pairs.length > 0) {
    const seriesRows = await db
      .select({
        itemId: sql<string>`c.item_id`,
        date: sql<string>`c.day`,
        total: sql<number>`c.total`.mapWith(Number),
        parts: sql<number[]>`c.parts`,
      })
      .from(
        sql`(
          with segs(item_id, shift_id, slot) as (values ${sql.join(pairs, sql`, `)}),
          days as (
            select d::date as day
            from generate_series(${previous.from}::date, ${period.to}::date, interval '1 day') as g(d)
          ),
          cells as (
            select sg.item_id, dd.day, sg.slot,
              coalesce(sum(hi.quantity), 0) as quantity
            from segs sg
            cross join days dd
            left join handover h
              on h.shift_id = sg.shift_id and h.operational_date = dd.day
              and ${DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL}
            left join handover_item hi
              on hi.handover_id = h.id and hi.item_id = sg.item_id
              and hi.item_kind_snapshot = 'control'
            group by sg.item_id, dd.day, sg.slot
          )
          select item_id, day::text as day,
            sum(quantity)::int as total,
            array_agg(quantity::int order by slot) as parts
          from cells
          group by item_id, day
        ) as c`,
      )
      .orderBy(sql`c.item_id`, sql`c.day`);
    for (const row of seriesRows) {
      const list = seriesOf.get(row.itemId) ?? [];
      list.push({ date: row.date, total: row.total, parts: row.parts });
      seriesOf.set(row.itemId, list);
    }
  }

  const metrics: ControlItemMetric[] = items.map((row) => ({
    itemId: row.itemId,
    sectorId: row.sectorId,
    sectorName: row.sectorName,
    name: row.name,
    unit: row.unit,
    total: row.total,
    previousTotal: row.previousTotal,
    handoverCount: row.handoverCount,
    average: row.average,
    segments: segmentsOf.get(row.itemId) ?? [],
    series: seriesOf.get(row.itemId) ?? [],
  }));
  return { items: metrics, totalItems: items[0]?.totalItems ?? 0 };
}
```
