- [ ] **Step 7: Write minimal implementation de `getStockData`**

Crie `src/features/dashboard/stock.ts`:

```ts
import "server-only";

import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { sectorScopeOf } from "@/features/authz/sectorScope";

import { DASHBOARD_ITEM_LIMIT } from "./limits";
import {
  chronologyOrderSql,
  DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL,
  handoverScopeSql,
} from "./sql";
import type {
  DashboardQuery,
  StockData,
  StockItemMetric,
  StockPoint,
} from "./types";

const EMPTY: StockData = { items: [], totalItems: 0 };

/**
 * Itens de estoque: a última contagem até o fim do período (mesmo anterior ao
 * início) e, por dia do período, a última contagem do dia (`null` sem contagem).
 * Duas consultas, as duas agregadas no SQL.
 */
export async function getStockData(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: DashboardQuery,
): Promise<StockData> {
  const scope = sectorScopeOf(actor, input.sectorId);
  if (scope.kind === "nothing") return EMPTY;
  const { period } = input;

  const itemScope =
    scope.kind === "all" ? sql`true` : sql`i.sector_id = ${scope.sectorId}`;

  // 1. Itens (ativos do escopo ∪ com contagem no período) e a última contagem.
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      itemId: sql<string>`c.item_id`,
      sectorId: sql<string>`c.sector_id`,
      sectorName: sql<string>`c.sector_name`,
      name: sql<string>`c.name`,
      unit: sql<string>`c.unit`,
      quantity: sql<number | null>`c.quantity`.mapWith(Number),
      operationalDate: sql<string | null>`c.operational_date`,
      shiftName: sql<string | null>`c.shift_name`,
      handoverId: sql<string | null>`c.handover_id`,
      totalItems: sql<number>`c.total_items`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(
      sql`(
        with latest as (
          select distinct on (hi.item_id)
            hi.item_id, hi.quantity,
            hi.item_name_snapshot as name, hi.item_unit_snapshot as unit,
            h.operational_date,
            coalesce(h.shift_name_snapshot, s.name) as shift_name,
            h.id as handover_id
          from handover_item hi
          join handover h on h.id = hi.handover_id
          join shift s on s.id = h.shift_id
          join sector sec on sec.id = h.sector_id
          where hi.item_kind_snapshot = 'stock' and ${DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL}
            and h.operational_date <= ${period.to}::date
            and ${handoverScopeSql(scope)}
          order by hi.item_id, ${chronologyOrderSql()}
        ),
        counted as (
          select distinct hi.item_id
          from handover_item hi
          join handover h on h.id = hi.handover_id
          join sector sec on sec.id = h.sector_id
          where hi.item_kind_snapshot = 'stock' and ${DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL}
            and h.operational_date between ${period.from}::date and ${period.to}::date
            and ${handoverScopeSql(scope)}
        )
        select i.id as item_id, i.sector_id, sec.name as sector_name,
          coalesce(l.name, i.name) as name, coalesce(l.unit, i.unit) as unit,
          l.quantity, l.operational_date::text as operational_date,
          l.shift_name, l.handover_id,
          count(*) over () as total_items,
          row_number() over (order by lower(sec.name), i.sort_order, i.id) as ord
        from item i
        join sector sec on sec.id = i.sector_id
        left join latest l on l.item_id = i.id
        where sec.active and ${itemScope}
          and ((i.active and i.kind = 'stock') or i.id in (select item_id from counted))
        order by ord
        limit ${DASHBOARD_ITEM_LIMIT}
      ) as c`,
    )
    .orderBy(sql`c.ord`);
  if (rows.length === 0) return EMPTY;

  const idList = sql.join(
    rows.map((row) => sql`${row.itemId}::uuid`),
    sql`, `,
  );

  // 2. Um ponto por item e dia do período: a última contagem do dia (a mesma
  //    ordem cronológica) ou null.
  const pointRows = await db
    .select({
      itemId: sql<string>`c.item_id`,
      date: sql<string>`c.day`,
      quantity: sql<number | null>`c.quantity`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(
      sql`(
        with per_day as (
          select distinct on (hi.item_id, h.operational_date)
            hi.item_id, h.operational_date, hi.quantity
          from handover_item hi
          join handover h on h.id = hi.handover_id
          join shift s on s.id = h.shift_id
          where hi.item_id in (${idList}) and hi.item_kind_snapshot = 'stock'
            and ${DELIVERED_HANDOVER_SQL}
            and h.operational_date between ${period.from}::date and ${period.to}::date
          order by hi.item_id, ${chronologyOrderSql()}
        )
        select x.item_id, d.day::text as day, p.quantity
        from (select unnest(array[${idList}]) as item_id) x
        cross join (
          select g::date as day
          from generate_series(${period.from}::date, ${period.to}::date, interval '1 day') as s(g)
        ) d
        left join per_day p on p.item_id = x.item_id and p.operational_date = d.day
      ) as c`,
    )
    .orderBy(sql`c.item_id`, sql`c.day`);

  const pointsOf = new Map<string, StockPoint[]>();
  for (const row of pointRows) {
    const list = pointsOf.get(row.itemId) ?? [];
    list.push({ date: row.date, quantity: row.quantity });
    pointsOf.set(row.itemId, list);
  }

  const items: StockItemMetric[] = rows.map((row) => ({
    itemId: row.itemId,
    sectorId: row.sectorId,
    sectorName: row.sectorName,
    name: row.name,
    unit: row.unit,
    last:
      row.quantity !== null &&
      row.operationalDate !== null &&
      row.shiftName !== null &&
      row.handoverId !== null
        ? {
            quantity: row.quantity,
            unit: row.unit,
            operationalDate: row.operationalDate,
            shiftName: row.shiftName,
            handoverId: row.handoverId,
          }
        : null,
    lastBeforePeriod:
      row.operationalDate !== null && row.operationalDate < period.from,
    points: pointsOf.get(row.itemId) ?? [],
  }));
  return { items, totalItems: rows[0]?.totalItems ?? 0 };
}
```

```ts
      name: "Ana Teste",
    });
    const doca = await insertDestination(db, { name: "Doca 3" });
    return { sector, ana, doca };
  }

  it("parada: 72 h exatas não, 72 h + 1 ms sim (fim da janela é estrito)", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, doca } = await base();
    const exact = new Date(NOW.getTime() - 72 * 3_600_000);
    const over = new Date(NOW.getTime() - 72 * 3_600_000 - 1);
    for (const at of [exact, over]) {
      await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationId: doca.id,
        createdAt: at,
      });
    }
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id), NOW);
    expect(data.open).toBe(2);
    expect(data.stale).toBe(1);
  });

  it("parada: o status em trânsito conta pelo último movimento, não pela criação", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, doca } = await base();
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      destinationId: doca.id,
      status: "in_transit",
      createdAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() - 100 * 3_600_000),
      statusChangedAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() - 10 * 3_600_000),
    });
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id), NOW);
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ open: 1, stale: 0 });
  });

  it("entrega às 23:59 do último dia entra e à 00:00 do dia seguinte sai (dia de São Paulo)", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, doca } = await base();
    const make = async (at: Date) => {
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationId: doca.id,
        status: "delivered",
        createdAt: new Date(at.getTime() - 3_600_000),
        statusChangedAt: at,
        events: false,
      });
      await insertRequestEvent(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        fromStatus: null,
        toStatus: "requested",
        changedBy: ana.id,
        changedAt: new Date(at.getTime() - 3_600_000),
      });
      await insertRequestEvent(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        fromStatus: "requested",
        toStatus: "delivered",
        changedBy: ana.id,
        changedAt: at,
      });
    };
    await make(spDate("2026-11-20", "23:59"));
    await make(spDate("2026-11-21", "00:00"));
    await make(spDate("2026-11-14", "00:00"));
    await make(spDate("2026-11-13", "23:59"));
    const data = await getRequestsData(
      db,
      ADMIN,
      query(sector.id),
      spDate("2026-11-21", "12:00"),
    );
    expect(data.deliveredInPeriod).toBe(2);
  });

  it("destinos: vários 'Outro' (textos livres diferentes) são um grupo só; teto de 8 com totalDestinations", async () => {
    const { sector, ana } = await base();
    for (let n = 1; n <= 9; n += 1) {
      const destination = await insertDestination(db, {
        name: `Destino ${String(n).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      });
      await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationId: destination.id,
        status: "delivered",
        createdAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "08:00"),
        statusChangedAt: new Date(
          spDate("2026-11-16", "08:00").getTime() + n * 600_000,
        ),
        events: true,
      });
    }
    for (const text of ["Pátio A", "Pátio B"]) {
      await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationOther: text,
        status: "delivered",
        createdAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "08:00"),
        statusChangedAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "08:05"),
        events: true,
      });
    }
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id), NOW);
    // 9 destinos da lista + o grupo "Outro" = 10 grupos; as 8 barras são as de
    // maior tempo médio, em ordem decrescente.
    expect(data.totalDestinations).toBe(10);
    expect(data.destinations).toHaveLength(8);
    expect(data.destinations.map((row) => row.averageSeconds)).toEqual(
      [...data.destinations.map((row) => row.averageSeconds)].sort(
        (a, b) => b - a,
      ),
    );
    expect(data.destinations[0]).toMatchObject({
      name: "Destino 09",
      averageSeconds: 5_400,
    });
    expect(
      data.destinations.filter((row) => row.destinationId === null),
    ).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("'Outro' aparece com os textos livres juntos quando está entre as 8 barras", async () => {
    const { sector, ana } = await base();
    for (const text of ["Pátio A", "Pátio B"]) {
      await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationOther: text,
        status: "delivered",
        createdAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "08:00"),
        statusChangedAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "08:10"),
        events: true,
      });
    }
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id), NOW);
    expect(data.destinations).toEqual([
      {
        key: "outro",
        destinationId: null,
        name: "Outro",
        deliveredCount: 2,
        averageSeconds: 600,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("itens: teto de 12 com totalItems, ordem por solicitações e depois quantidade", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, doca } = await base();
    for (let n = 1; n <= 13; n += 1) {
      const created = await insertItem(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        name: `Item ${String(n).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        unit: "peça",
        kind: "stock",
        sortOrder: n,
      });
      const request = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationId: doca.id,
        createdAt: spDate("2026-11-18", "08:00"),
      });
      await insertRequestItem(db, {
        requestId: request.id,
        itemId: created.id,
        quantity: n,
      });
    }
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id), NOW);
    expect(data.totalItems).toBe(13);
    expect(data.items).toHaveLength(12);
    // Todos têm 1 solicitação: vence a maior quantidade.
    expect(data.items[0]).toMatchObject({ name: "Item 13", quantity: 13 });
    expect(data.items[11]).toMatchObject({ name: "Item 02", quantity: 2 });
  });

  it("item cuja unidade mudou no período: uma linha só, com a unidade da solicitação mais recente", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, doca } = await base();
    const stretch = await insertItem(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Stretch",
      unit: "rolo",
      kind: "stock",
      sortOrder: 1,
    });
    const first = await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      destinationId: doca.id,
      createdAt: spDate("2026-11-15", "08:00"),
    });
    await insertRequestItem(db, {
      requestId: first.id,
      itemId: stretch.id,
      quantity: 3,
    });
    await db.update(item).set({ unit: "caixa" }).where(eq(item.id, stretch.id));
    const second = await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      destinationId: doca.id,
      createdAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "08:00"),
    });
    await insertRequestItem(db, {
      requestId: second.id,
      itemId: stretch.id,
      quantity: 4,
    });
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, query(sector.id), NOW);
    expect(data.items).toEqual([
      {
        itemId: stretch.id,
        sectorId: sector.id,
        sectorName: "Setor Teste",
        name: "Stretch",
        unit: "caixa",
        quantity: 7,
        requestCount: 2,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("cancelada fora da quantidade pedida; criada fora do período também", async () => {
    const { sector, ana, doca } = await base();
    const net = await insertItem(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      name: "Rede",
      kind: "stock",
      sortOrder: 1,
    });
    const make = async (
      createdAt: Date,
      status: "requested" | "cancelled",
      quantity: number,
    ) => {
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: sector.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationId: doca.id,
        createdAt,
        ...(status === "cancelled"
          ? {
              status,
              statusChangedAt: new Date(createdAt.getTime() + 3_600_000),
            }
          : {}),
      });
      await insertRequestItem(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        itemId: net.id,
        quantity,
      });
    };
    await make(spDate("2026-11-16", "08:00"), "requested", 2);
    await make(spDate("2026-11-16", "09:00"), "cancelled", 50);
    await make(spDate("2026-11-13", "23:59"), "requested", 70);
    await make(spDate("2026-11-21", "00:00"), "requested", 90);
    const data = await getRequestsData(
      db,
      ADMIN,
      query(sector.id),
      spDate("2026-11-21", "12:00"),
    );
    expect(data.items.map((row) => [row.quantity, row.requestCount])).toEqual([
      [2, 1],
    ]);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the failing test de paridade número × Tabela**

Crie `src/features/dashboard/requests.parity.test.ts`. Cada número é comparado com o total da Tabela que o link dele abre, lido de volta por `parseRequestFilters` e passando pela mesma validação que a tela faz (o item precisa estar em `listFilterItems`, o destino em `listFilterDestinations`):

```ts
import type { PGlite } from "@electric-sql/pglite";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import {
  listFilterDestinations,
  listFilterItems,
} from "@/features/requests/choices";
import { listRequestTable } from "@/features/requests/lists";
import {
  parseRequestFilters,
  type RequestFilters,
} from "@/features/requests/requestFilters";
import { hrefQuery, queryRecord } from "@/lib/searchParams";
import { authzOf } from "../../../test/authz";
import {
  type DashboardWorld,
  seedDashboardWorld,
} from "../../../test/dashboardWorld";
import { createTestDb, type TestDb } from "../../../test/db";
import {
  deliveredRequestsHref,
  destinationDeliveriesHref,
  linkExtras,
  openRequestsHref,
  requestedItemHref,
  staleRequestsHref,
} from "./links";
import { getRequestsData } from "./requests";
import type { DashboardQuery } from "./types";

// Cada número do bloco Solicitações é o total da Tabela que o link dele abre
// (D-F5-3). Os links são lidos de volta pelo parse da tela e passam pela mesma
// validação que a tela faz antes de consultar (item e destino conhecidos).

const ADMIN = authzOf({ role: "admin" });

let client: PGlite;
let db: TestDb;
let world: DashboardWorld;

beforeAll(async () => {
  ({ client, db } = await createTestDb());
  world = await seedDashboardWorld(db);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await client.close();
});

// O que a tela faz com o href: parse, ?item= desconhecido vira null, destino
// desconhecido vira null.
async function screenFilters(
  href: string,
  sectorId: string | null,
): Promise<RequestFilters> {
  const parsed = parseRequestFilters(queryRecord(hrefQuery(href)), world.today);
  const items = await listFilterItems(db, ADMIN, sectorId, parsed.itemId);
  const destinations = await listFilterDestinations(db);
  return {
    ...parsed,
    itemId: items.some((entry) => entry.id === parsed.itemId)
      ? parsed.itemId
      : null,
    destination:
      parsed.destination === "outro" ||
      destinations.some((entry) => entry.id === parsed.destination)
        ? parsed.destination
        : null,
  };
}

const SCOPES: readonly [string, () => string | null][] = [
  ["ULD", () => world.uld.id],
  ["Câmara", () => world.camara.id],
  ["Todos os setores", () => null],
];

describe.each(SCOPES)("número × total da Tabela (%s)", (_name, scopeOf) => {
  const queryOf = (sectorId: string | null): DashboardQuery => ({
    sectorId,
    period: { from: world.period.from, to: world.period.to },
    previous: world.previous,
  });
  const totalOf = async (href: string, sectorId: string | null) =>
    (
      await listRequestTable(
        db,
        ADMIN,
        { sectorId, filters: await screenFilters(href, sectorId) },
        world.now,
      )
    ).total;

  it("abertas, paradas e entregues no período", async () => {
    const sectorId = scopeOf();
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(sectorId), world.now);
    const extras = linkExtras(sectorId === null ? "todos" : sectorId);
    expect(await totalOf(openRequestsHref(extras), sectorId)).toBe(data.open);
    expect(await totalOf(staleRequestsHref(extras), sectorId)).toBe(data.stale);
    expect(
      await totalOf(deliveredRequestsHref(world.period, extras), sectorId),
    ).toBe(data.deliveredInPeriod);
    expect(data.deliveredInPeriod).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("cada barra de destino (inclusive 'outro' e o destino inativo)", async () => {
    const sectorId = scopeOf();
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(sectorId), world.now);
    const extras = linkExtras(sectorId === null ? "todos" : sectorId);
    expect(data.destinations.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const destination of data.destinations) {
      const href = destinationDeliveriesHref(
        world.period,
        destination.key,
        extras,
      );
      expect(await totalOf(href, sectorId), destination.name).toBe(
        destination.deliveredCount,
      );
    }
  });

  it("cada item pedido (criadas no período, sem as canceladas)", async () => {
    const sectorId = scopeOf();
    const data = await getRequestsData(db, ADMIN, queryOf(sectorId), world.now);
    const extras = linkExtras(sectorId === null ? "todos" : sectorId);
    expect(data.items.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const row of data.items) {
      const href = requestedItemHref(world.period, row.itemId, extras);
      const filters = await screenFilters(href, sectorId);
      // A tela mantém o item do link (ele está nas escolhas do escopo).
      expect(filters.itemId, row.name).toBe(row.itemId);
      expect(await totalOf(href, sectorId), row.name).toBe(row.requestCount);
    }
  });
});

describe("a Tabela do link respeita o escopo do operador", () => {
  it("o operador da Câmara abrindo o link do item da ULD vê 0 (o item é de outro setor)", async () => {
    const href = requestedItemHref(world.period, world.items.net);
    const parsed = parseRequestFilters(
      queryRecord(hrefQuery(href)),
      world.today,
    );
    const table = await listRequestTable(
      db,
      world.people.cris,
      { sectorId: null, filters: parsed },
      world.now,
    );
    expect(table.total).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write minimal implementation de `getRequestsData`**

Crie `src/features/dashboard/requests.ts`:

```ts
import "server-only";

import { and, desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { PgColumn } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

import { destination, item } from "@/db/schema/catalog";
import { request, requestItem } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import { sector } from "@/db/schema/sectors";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { DESTINATION_OTHER } from "@/features/requests/limits";
import {
  createdBetweenSql,
  deliveredBetweenSql,
  firstDeliveredAtSql,
  requestScopeSql,
  staleSql,
} from "@/features/requests/sql";
import { OPEN_STATUSES } from "@/features/requests/status";

import { DESTINATION_BAR_LIMIT, REQUESTED_ITEM_LIMIT } from "./limits";
import type {
  DashboardQuery,
  DestinationDelivery,
  RequestedItem,
  RequestsData,
} from "./types";

const OTHER_LABEL = "Outro";

/**
 * Solicitações do dashboard. Abertas e paradas são "agora"; entregues, tempo
 * até a entrega e quantidade pedida são do período. A tabela `request` nunca
 * tem alias (os fragmentos de features/requests/sql.ts escrevem "request").
 */
export async function getRequestsData(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: DashboardQuery,
  now: Date,
): Promise<RequestsData> {
  const { period } = input;
  const scope = requestScopeSql(actor, input.sectorId);
  const open = sql`${request.status} in (${sql.join(
    OPEN_STATUSES.map((status) => sql`${status}`),
    sql`, `,
  )})`;
  const delivered = deliveredBetweenSql(period.from, period.to);

  const averageSeconds = sql<number>`avg(extract(epoch from (${firstDeliveredAtSql()} - ${request.createdAt})))::float8`;
  const destinationName = sql<string>`coalesce(${destination.name}, ${OTHER_LABEL})`;
  const deliveredCount = sql<number>`count(*)`.mapWith(Number);

  const latest = (column: PgColumn) =>
    sql<string>`(array_agg(${column} order by ${request.createdAt} desc, ${request.id} desc))[1]`;
  const itemName = latest(requestItem.itemNameSnapshot);
  const requestCount = sql<number>`count(*)`.mapWith(Number);
  const quantity = sql<number>`sum(${requestItem.quantity})`.mapWith(Number);

  const [countRows, destinationRows, itemRows] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        open: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${open})`.mapWith(Number),
        stale:
          sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${open} and ${staleSql(now, request.status, request.statusChangedAt)})`.mapWith(
            Number,
          ),
        deliveredInPeriod:
          sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${delivered})`.mapWith(Number),
      })
      .from(request)
      .where(scope),
    db
      .select({
        destinationId: request.destinationId,
        name: destinationName,
        deliveredCount,
        averageSeconds,
        totalDestinations: sql<number>`count(*) over ()`.mapWith(Number),
      })
      .from(request)
      .leftJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
      .where(and(scope, delivered))
      .groupBy(request.destinationId, destination.name)
      .orderBy(
        desc(averageSeconds),
        desc(deliveredCount),
        sql`lower(${destinationName})`,
        sql`${request.destinationId} nulls last`,
      )
      .limit(DESTINATION_BAR_LIMIT),
    db
      .select({
        itemId: requestItem.itemId,
        sectorId: item.sectorId,
        sectorName: sector.name,
        name: itemName,
        unit: latest(requestItem.itemUnitSnapshot),
        quantity,
        requestCount,
        totalItems: sql<number>`count(*) over ()`.mapWith(Number),
      })
      .from(requestItem)
      .innerJoin(request, eq(request.id, requestItem.requestId))
      .innerJoin(item, eq(item.id, requestItem.itemId))
      .innerJoin(sector, eq(sector.id, item.sectorId))
      .where(
        and(
          scope,
          createdBetweenSql(period.from, period.to),
          sql`"request"."status" <> 'cancelled'`,
        ),
      )
      .groupBy(requestItem.itemId, item.sectorId, sector.name)
      .orderBy(
        desc(requestCount),
        desc(quantity),
        sql`lower(${itemName})`,
        requestItem.itemId,
      )
      .limit(REQUESTED_ITEM_LIMIT),
  ]);

  const counts = countRows[0];
  const destinations: DestinationDelivery[] = destinationRows.map((row) => ({
    key: row.destinationId ?? DESTINATION_OTHER,
    destinationId: row.destinationId,
    name: row.name,
    deliveredCount: row.deliveredCount,
    averageSeconds: row.averageSeconds,
  }));
  const items: RequestedItem[] = itemRows.map((row) => ({
    itemId: row.itemId,
    sectorId: row.sectorId,
    sectorName: row.sectorName,
    name: row.name,
    unit: row.unit,
    quantity: row.quantity,
    requestCount: row.requestCount,
  }));

  return {
    open: counts?.open ?? 0,
    stale: counts?.stale ?? 0,
    deliveredInPeriod: counts?.deliveredInPeriod ?? 0,
    destinations,
    totalDestinations: destinationRows[0]?.totalDestinations ?? 0,
    items,
    totalItems: itemRows[0]?.totalItems ?? 0,
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the failing test: `usePrefersReducedMotion`**

Crie `src/components/dashboard/usePrefersReducedMotion.test.tsx` (projeto dom: o projeto node não tem `window`):

```tsx
import { act, renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { usePrefersReducedMotion } from "./usePrefersReducedMotion";

type Listener = EventListenerOrEventListenerObject;

function mockMedia(initial: boolean) {
  const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  const state = { matches: initial };
  vi.spyOn(window, "matchMedia").mockImplementation((query: string) => ({
    get matches() {
      return state.matches;
    },
    media: query,
    onchange: null,
    addEventListener: (_type: string, listener: Listener) => {
      listeners.add(listener);
    },
    removeEventListener: (_type: string, listener: Listener) => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    },
    addListener: () => {},
    removeListener: () => {},
    dispatchEvent: () => false,
  }));
  return {
    listeners,
    change(matches: boolean) {
      state.matches = matches;
      const event = new Event("change");
      for (const listener of listeners) {
        if (typeof listener === "function") {
          listener(event);
        } else {
          listener.handleEvent(event);
        }
      }
    },
  };
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
});

describe("usePrefersReducedMotion", () => {
  it("false quando a pessoa não pediu menos movimento", () => {
    mockMedia(false);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => usePrefersReducedMotion());
    expect(result.current).toBe(false);
  });

  it("true quando pediu", () => {
    mockMedia(true);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => usePrefersReducedMotion());
    expect(result.current).toBe(true);
  });

  it("acompanha a mudança sem recarregar e solta o ouvinte ao desmontar", () => {
    const media = mockMedia(false);
    const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => usePrefersReducedMotion());
    expect(media.listeners.size).toBe(1);
    act(() => media.change(true));
    expect(result.current).toBe(true);
    act(() => media.change(false));
    expect(result.current).toBe(false);
    unmount();
    expect(media.listeners.size).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```tsx
  });

  it("um dia só (período de 1 dia) renderiza", () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <StockTrendChart
        label="Stretch"
        points={[{ date: "2026-11-20", quantity: 7 }]}
        unit="rolos"
      />,
    );
    expect(container.querySelector("[data-slot=chart]")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(
      screen
        .getAllByRole("row")
        .filter((row) => row.textContent?.includes("7")),
    ).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("sem nenhuma contagem no período: texto de vazio, sem gráfico", () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <StockTrendChart
        label="Stretch"
        points={POINTS.map((point) => ({ ...point, quantity: null }))}
        unit="rolos"
      />,
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Sem contagem no período.")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(container.querySelector("[data-slot=chart]")).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Write the failing test: `MetricCard`**

Crie `src/components/kokonutui/metric-card.test.tsx`. Os `total` dos pontos da série **não** batem de propósito com as `parts` (e os totais dos turnos não batem com a soma dos pontos): quem somasse no cliente erraria o teste.

```tsx
import { render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { computeDelta, deltaText } from "@/features/dashboard/delta";
import {
  MetricCard,
  type MetricCardProps,
  type MetricPoint,
  type MetricSegment,
} from "./metric-card";

const ITEM_HREF =
  "/passagens?situacao=entregues&item=11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";

function segment(
  key: string,
  label: string,
  swatchClass: string,
  strokeClass: string,
  total: number,
  previousTotal: number,
): MetricSegment {
  return {
    key,
    label,
    swatchClass,
    strokeClass,
    total,
    previousTotal,
    href: `${ITEM_HREF}&turno=${key}`,
  };
}

const MORNING = segment(
  "manha",
  "Manhã",
  "bg-chart-1",
  "stroke-chart-1",
  30,
  20,
);
const AFTERNOON = segment(
  "tarde",
  "Tarde",
  "bg-chart-2",
  "stroke-chart-2",
  40,
  50,
);

// 14 dias (2 × 7): de 07/11 a 20/11. Os `total` e as `parts` NÃO batem de propósito (o `total`
// do dia vem do SQL, e o cartão nunca soma as partes): quem somasse no cliente erraria o teste.
const DATES = Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => {
  const day = 7 + i;
  return `2026-11-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
});
const TOTALS = [4, 6, 5, 8, 7, 3, 6, 9, 11, 10, 12, 8, 7, 13];
const SERIES: MetricPoint[] = DATES.map((date, i) => ({
  date,
  total: TOTALS[i],
  parts: [1, 2],
}));

function props(overrides: Partial<MetricCardProps> = {}): MetricCardProps {
  return {
    label: "Rede de proteção",
    unit: "peças",
    context: null,
    periodDays: 7,
    total: 70,
    average: 11.7,
    handoverCount: 6,
    delta: computeDelta(70, 50),
    segments: [MORNING, AFTERNOON],
    series: SERIES,
    href: ITEM_HREF,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

let errorSpy: ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn>;
beforeEach(() => {
  errorSpy = vi.spyOn(console, "error");
});
afterEach(() => {
  expect(errorSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  errorSpy.mockRestore();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
});

function mockReducedMotion(reduced: boolean) {
  vi.spyOn(window, "matchMedia").mockImplementation((query: string) => ({
    matches: reduced && query.includes("prefers-reduced-motion"),
    media: query,
    onchange: null,
    addEventListener: () => {},
    removeEventListener: () => {},
    addListener: () => {},
    removeListener: () => {},
    dispatchEvent: () => false,
  }));
}

describe("MetricCard", () => {
  it("mostra rótulo, unidade, setor, total pt-BR com unidade e o link do total", () => {
    render(<MetricCard {...props({ context: "ULD Teste", total: 1234 })} />);
    expect(screen.getByText("Rede de proteção")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("ULD Teste")).toBeInTheDocument();
    const total = screen.getByRole("link", {
      name: "1.234 peças: ver as passagens do período",
    });
    expect(total).toHaveAttribute("href", ITEM_HREF);
  });

  it("média por turno e a legenda de passagens, que é outro link para a mesma lista", () => {
    render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/média de 11,7 por turno/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    const count = screen.getByRole("link", { name: "6 passagens" });
    expect(count).toHaveAttribute("href", ITEM_HREF);
  });

  it("usa o singular com uma passagem e não escreve 'média' sem média", () => {
    render(<MetricCard {...props({ handoverCount: 1, average: null })} />);
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("link", { name: "1 passagem" }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/média de/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it.each([
    ["up", computeDelta(12, 10)],
    ["down", computeDelta(8, 10)],
    ["same", computeDelta(10, 10)],
    ["none", computeDelta(10, 0)],
  ] as const)("variação %s: ícone e texto, sem cor de bom ou ruim", (_kind, delta) => {
    const { container } = render(<MetricCard {...props({ delta })} />);
    const text = deltaText(delta);
    expect(screen.getAllByText(text).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const badge = screen.getByRole("img", {
      name:
        delta.kind === "none"
          ? "Sem dados no período anterior para comparar"
          : text,
    });
    expect(badge.className).toContain("text-muted-foreground");
    expect(container.innerHTML).not.toMatch(
      /text-success|text-destructive|text-warning/,
    );
  });

  it("escala rotulada: 0 na base e o maior valor desenhado, com a unidade, no topo", () => {
    render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    // O maior dos 14 pontos é 13 (nenhuma soma).
    expect(screen.getByText("13 peças")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      within(screen.getByRole("slider")).getByText("0"),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Período atual")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Período anterior")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("sem passagens com o item: rótulo, unidade e o texto de vazio, sem gráfico", () => {
    render(
      <MetricCard
        {...props({ handoverCount: 0, average: null, total: 0, series: [] })}
      />,
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Rede de proteção")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("peças")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Sem passagens no período")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("slider")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("período de 1 dia e série curta renderizam sem erro", () => {
    render(
      <MetricCard
        {...props({
          periodDays: 1,
          series: SERIES.slice(-2),
          total: 13,
          handoverCount: 1,
        })}
      />,
    );
    const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "1");
    expect(slider.parentElement?.innerHTML).not.toContain("NaN");
  });

  it("um turno só: sem o detalhamento 'Por turno'", () => {
    render(<MetricCard {...props({ segments: [MORNING] })} />);
    expect(screen.queryByText("Por turno")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("seis turnos: seis linhas, todas com link; slots 1 a 4 com cor própria e o 5º e o 6º neutros", () => {
    const six = [
      segment("a", "Turno A", "bg-chart-1", "stroke-chart-1", 6, 1),
      segment("b", "Turno B", "bg-chart-2", "stroke-chart-2", 5, 1),
      segment("c", "Turno C", "bg-chart-3", "stroke-chart-3", 4, 1),
      segment("d", "Turno D", "bg-chart-4", "stroke-chart-4", 3, 1),
      segment("e", "Turno E", "bg-foreground", "stroke-foreground", 2, 1),
      segment("f", "Turno F", "bg-foreground", "stroke-foreground", 1, 1),
    ];
    render(<MetricCard {...props({ segments: six, total: 21 })} />);
    const rows = screen.getAllByRole("listitem");
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(6);
    for (const row of rows) {
      expect(within(row).getByRole("link")).toHaveAttribute(
        "href",
        expect.stringContaining("turno="),
      );
    }
    const dots = rows.map(
      (row) => row.querySelector("span.size-2")?.className ?? "",
    );
    expect(dots.slice(0, 4).map((c) => c.match(/bg-chart-\d/)?.[0])).toEqual([
      "bg-chart-1",
      "bg-chart-2",
      "bg-chart-3",
      "bg-chart-4",
    ]);
    expect(dots[4]).toContain("bg-foreground");
    expect(dots[5]).toContain("bg-foreground");
    expect(dots.join(" ")).not.toContain("bg-chart-5");
  });

  it("cada turno mostra total (link), participação e o botão de foco com aria-pressed", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    const link = screen.getByRole("link", {
      name: "30 peças em Manhã: ver as passagens",
    });
    expect(link).toHaveAttribute("href", `${ITEM_HREF}&turno=manha`);
    // 30 de 70 = 43%.
    expect(screen.getByText("43%")).toBeInTheDocument();
    const button = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Mostrar só Manhã" });
    expect(button).toHaveAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
    await user.click(button);
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Mostrar todos os turnos" }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
    expect(screen.getByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent(
      "Mostrando só Manhã: 30 peças",
    );
  });

  it("foco num turno: o número e a variação são do turno (prontos do servidor), a linha usa a cor do turno e nenhum swatch muda de classe", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const { container } = render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    const swatches = () =>
      Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("li span.size-2")).map(
        (node) => node.className,
      );
    const before = swatches();
    expect(
      container.querySelector("path.stroke-foreground:not(.opacity-25)"),
    ).not.toBeNull();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Mostrar só Manhã" }));

    // O número grande vira o total do turno (30), com o link do turno.
    const big = screen.getByRole("link", {
      name: "30 peças: ver as passagens do período",
    });
    expect(big).toHaveAttribute("href", `${ITEM_HREF}&turno=manha`);
    // Variação do turno: 30 contra 20 = +50%, e não a do item (+40%).
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("img", { name: deltaText(computeDelta(30, 20)) }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      container.querySelector("path.stroke-chart-1:not(.opacity-25)"),
    ).not.toBeNull();
    expect(container.querySelector("path.stroke-foreground")).toBeNull();
    // Mesmas classes de antes: nem "tinta" no foco, nem ciclo por índice.
    expect(swatches()).toEqual(before);
    // A escala vira a do turno: o maior valor desenhado de `parts[0]` é 1.
    expect(screen.getByText("1 peças")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("setas, Home e End leem um dia por vez; Escape e o botão voltam ao período", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "70 peças no período");
    slider.focus();
    await user.keyboard("{Home}");
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "14/11/2026: 9 peças");
    await user.keyboard("{ArrowRight}");
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "15/11/2026: 11 peças");
    await user.keyboard("{End}");
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "20/11/2026: 13 peças");
    await user.keyboard("{ArrowLeft}");
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "19/11/2026: 7 peças");
    // O dia gêmeo do período anterior é o do mesmo índice (7 dias antes).
    expect(screen.getByText("19/11/2026 vs 12/11/2026")).toBeInTheDocument();
    // O número lido é de um dia: deixa de ser o link do período.
    expect(
      screen.queryByRole("link", {
        name: "7 peças: ver as passagens do período",
      }),
    ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.keyboard("{Escape}");
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "70 peças no período");
    await user.keyboard("{ArrowLeft}");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Voltar ao período" }));
    expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuetext", "70 peças no período");
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("link", {
        name: "70 peças: ver as passagens do período",
      }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("o dia lido compara com o gêmeo do período anterior", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    screen.getByRole("slider").focus();
    await user.keyboard("{Home}");
    // 14/11 = 9, gêmeo 07/11 = 4: +125%.
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("img", { name: deltaText(computeDelta(9, 4)) }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("movimento reduzido: trocar o turno em foco não agenda animação", async () => {
    mockReducedMotion(true);
    const raf = vi.spyOn(window, "requestAnimationFrame");
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Mostrar só Manhã" }));
    expect(raf).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("com movimento normal, trocar o turno anima as linhas", async () => {
    mockReducedMotion(false);
    const raf = vi.spyOn(window, "requestAnimationFrame");
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Mostrar só Manhã" }));
    expect(raf).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("só português e só tokens: nada de texto em inglês nem de classe de cor crua", () => {
    const { container } = render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    expect(container.textContent).not.toMatch(
      /Revenue|vs previous|Show |previous period|Clear/,
    );
    expect(container.innerHTML).not.toMatch(
      /\b(?:bg|text|stroke|fill|border|ring)-(?:zinc|emerald|rose|orange|slate|gray|white|black)\b/,
    );
    expect(container.innerHTML).not.toMatch(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/);
  });

  it("o resumo para leitor de tela traz total, média, passagens e variação", () => {
    render(<MetricCard {...props()} />);
    expect(
      screen.getByText(
        `Resumo do período: total de 70 peças; média por turno de 11,7; 6 passagens; ${deltaText(computeDelta(70, 50))}.`,
      ),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

```ts
 * O guarda mede o que a tela PINTA: lê `chartColors.ts` (a única fonte das classes dos gráficos) e

const SITUATION_KEYS = Object.keys(SITUATION_TOKENS) as SituationKey[];

/** `{ stroke, dot }` de uma situação, sem o prefixo `stroke-` e `bg-`. */
function situationEntry(source: string, key: SituationKey) {
  const hit = new RegExp(
    `${key}:\\s*\\{\\s*stroke:\\s*"stroke-([a-z-]+)",\\s*dot:\\s*"bg-([a-z-]+)"`,
  ).exec(source);
  if (!hit?.[1] || !hit[2]) {
    throw new Error(`SITUATION_CHART.${key} não encontrado em chartColors.ts`);
  }
  return { stroke: hit[1], dot: hit[2] };
}

/** Os textos de `export const NAME = [ "a", "b" ]`. */
function stringList(source: string, name: string): string[] {
  const hit = new RegExp(`export const ${name} = \\[([^\\]]*)\\]`).exec(source);
  if (!hit?.[1]) {
    throw new Error(`${name} não encontrado em chartColors.ts`);
  }
  return [...hit[1].matchAll(/"([^"]+)"/g)].map((match) => match[1] ?? "");
}

function stringConstant(source: string, name: string): string {
  const hit = new RegExp(`export const ${name} = "([^"]+)"`).exec(source);
  if (!hit?.[1]) {
    throw new Error(`${name} não encontrado em chartColors.ts`);
  }
  return hit[1];
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- varredura dos componentes de gráfico
const CLASS_PREFIX =
  "(?:bg|text|stroke|fill|border|ring|ring-offset|outline|from|via|to|shadow|divide|accent|caret|decoration|placeholder)";
const RAW_COLOR =
  "(?:slate|gray|zinc|neutral|stone|red|orange|amber|yellow|lime|green|emerald|teal|cyan|sky|blue|indigo|violet|purple|fuchsia|pink|rose)";
// `(?<![\w-])` + variantes (`dark:`, `focus-visible:`, `hover:`…) antes do prefixo.
const VARIANTS = "(?<![\\w-])(?:[\\w-]+:)*";

const FORBIDDEN: readonly (readonly [string, RegExp])[] = [
  ["chart-5 ou acima", /chart-(?:[5-9]|\d{2,})(?!\d)/],
  [
    "cor crua do Tailwind",
    new RegExp(`${VARIANTS}${CLASS_PREFIX}-${RAW_COLOR}-\\d{2,3}(?![\\w-])`),
  ],
  [
    "branco ou preto crus",
    new RegExp(`${VARIANTS}${CLASS_PREFIX}-(?:white|black)(?![\\w-])`),
  ],
  ["hex", /#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}(?![\w-])/],
  ["cor arbitrária", /-\[(?:#|rgb|hsl|oklch)/],
];

function stripComments(source: string): string {
  return source
    .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "")
    .replace(/(^|[^:"'`])\/\/[^\n]*/g, "$1");
}

/** Os nomes das regras que o código reprova (vazio = limpo). */
function violationsIn(source: string): string[] {
  const code = stripComments(source);
  return FORBIDDEN.filter(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(code)).map(
    ([name]) => name,
  );
}

function chartSources(dir: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(dir).flatMap((name) => {
    const full = join(dir, name);
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) return chartSources(full);
    return /\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(name) && !/\.test\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(name)
      ? [full]
      : [];
  });
}

describe("varredura: nenhum componente de gráfico usa cor crua nem chart-5 ou acima", () => {
  const kokonut = chartSources(join(COMPONENTS_DIR, "kokonutui"));
  const dashboard = chartSources(join(COMPONENTS_DIR, "dashboard"));

  it("anti-vacuidade: acha os arquivos que deve varrer", () => {
    expect(kokonut.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(dashboard.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });

  it.each(
    [...kokonut, ...dashboard].map(
      (file) =>
        [
          file.slice(COMPONENTS_DIR.length + 1).replaceAll("\\", "/"),
          file,
        ] as const,
    ),
  )("%s", (_name, file) => {
    expect(violationsIn(readFileSync(file, "utf8"))).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { SegmentSlot } from "@/features/dashboard/types";
import type { HistorySituation } from "@/features/handovers/status";

// Classes LITERAIS: o Tailwind só gera o CSS do que aparece escrito inteiro, e o guarda de
// paleta (`chartPalette.test.ts`) lê este arquivo para medir o que a tela pinta.

/** Turno nos slots 1 a 4: a cor da entidade (turno), nunca ciclada. */
export const SHIFT_SWATCHES = [
  "bg-chart-1",
  "bg-chart-2",
  "bg-chart-3",
  "bg-chart-4",
] as const;
export const SHIFT_STROKES = [
  "stroke-chart-1",
  "stroke-chart-2",
  "stroke-chart-3",
  "stroke-chart-4",
] as const;

/** Turno do 5º em diante: sem cor própria, cada um continua com a própria linha e o link. */
export const OTHERS_SWATCH = "bg-foreground";
export const OTHERS_STROKE = "stroke-foreground";

export function segmentSwatch(slot: SegmentSlot): string {
  return slot === null ? OTHERS_SWATCH : SHIFT_SWATCHES[slot - 1];
}

export function segmentStroke(slot: SegmentSlot): string {
  return slot === null ? OTHERS_STROKE : SHIFT_STROKES[slot - 1];
}

/** A cor da situação é a do selo da lista (`-foreground` do token), não o fundo pastel dele. */
export const SITUATION_CHART: Readonly<
  Record<HistorySituation, { stroke: string; dot: string }>
> = {
  confirmed: {
    stroke: "stroke-success-foreground",
    dot: "bg-success-foreground",
  },
  awaiting: { stroke: "stroke-info-foreground", dot: "bg-info-foreground" },
  unconfirmed: {
    stroke: "stroke-warning-foreground",
    dot: "bg-warning-foreground",
  },
  missing: { stroke: "stroke-muted-foreground", dot: "bg-muted-foreground" },
};

/** Série única (linha do estoque), no `ChartConfig`. */
export const SINGLE_SERIES_COLOR = "var(--foreground)";
/** Barra única (destinos), no `BarList`. */
export const SINGLE_BAR_CLASS = "bg-foreground";
```

Crie `src/components/dashboard/usePrefersReducedMotion.ts`:

```ts
"use client";

import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

const QUERY = "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)";

function subscribe(onChange: () => void): () => void {
  const media = window.matchMedia(QUERY);
  media.addEventListener("change", onChange);
  return () => media.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
}

function getSnapshot(): boolean {
  return window.matchMedia(QUERY).matches;
}

// No servidor (e na hidratação) assume movimento normal; o cliente corrige logo depois.
function getServerSnapshot(): boolean {
  return false;
}

/** `true` quando a pessoa pediu menos movimento. Acompanha a mudança sem recarregar. */
export function usePrefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot);
}
```

Leia o arquivo (só para a ferramenta liberar a gravação) e **grave por cima** com Write, com o código abaixo: é o arquivo do CLI com o `biome-ignore` local no `ChartStyle` (a regra `noDangerouslySetInnerHtml` continua ligada no `biome.json`), o `organizeImports` resolvido e, no `ChartTooltipContent`, `formatInteger` (pt-BR) no lugar de `toLocaleString()` e `tabular-nums` no lugar de `font-mono`. O `cn` continua vindo de `"cn"`, como em todo primitivo de `src/components/ui/`.

```tsx
"use client";

import { cn } from "cn";
import * as React from "react";
import type { TooltipValueType } from "recharts";
import * as RechartsPrimitive from "recharts";

import { formatInteger } from "@/lib/numberFormat";

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = { light: "", dark: ".dark" } as const;

const INITIAL_DIMENSION = { width: 320, height: 200 } as const;
type TooltipNameType = number | string;

export type ChartConfig = Record<
  string,
  {
    label?: React.ReactNode;
    icon?: React.ComponentType;
  } & (
    | { color?: string; theme?: never }
    | { color?: never; theme: Record<keyof typeof THEMES, string> }
  )
>;

type ChartContextProps = {
  config: ChartConfig;
};

const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null);

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />");
  }

  return context;
}

function ChartContainer({
  id,
  className,
  children,
  config,
  initialDimension = INITIAL_DIMENSION,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  config: ChartConfig;
  children: React.ComponentProps<
    typeof RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
  >["children"];
  initialDimension?: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
  };
}) {
  const uniqueId = React.useId();
  const chartId = `chart-${id ?? uniqueId.replace(/:/g, "")}`;

  return (
    <ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-slot="chart"
        data-chart={chartId}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-hidden [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-hidden [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-hidden",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
          initialDimension={initialDimension}
        >
          {children}
        </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>
  );
}

const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(
    ([, config]) => config.theme ?? config.color,
  );

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <style
      // biome-ignore lint/security/noDangerouslySetInnerHtml: CSS gerado só a partir do ChartConfig do código (nunca de entrada do usuário)
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(
            ([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
  .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
    const color =
      itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] ??
      itemConfig.color;
    return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null;
  })
  .join("\n")}
}
`,
          )
          .join("\n"),
      }}
    />
  );
};

const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip;

function ChartTooltipContent({
  active,
  payload,
  className,
  indicator = "dot",
  hideLabel = false,
  hideIndicator = false,
  label,
  labelFormatter,
  labelClassName,
  formatter,
  color,
  nameKey,
  labelKey,
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    hideLabel?: boolean;
    hideIndicator?: boolean;
    indicator?: "line" | "dot" | "dashed";
    nameKey?: string;
    labelKey?: string;
  } & Omit<
    RechartsPrimitive.DefaultTooltipContentProps<
      TooltipValueType,
      TooltipNameType
    >,
    "accessibilityLayer"
  >) {
  const { config } = useChart();

  const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
      return null;
    }

    const [item] = payload;
    const key = `${labelKey ?? item?.dataKey ?? item?.name ?? "value"}`;
    const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
    const value =
      !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
        ? (config[label]?.label ?? label)
        : itemConfig?.label;

    if (labelFormatter) {
      return (
        <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
          {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (!value) {
      return null;
    }

    return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>;
  }, [
    label,
    labelFormatter,
    payload,
    hideLabel,
    labelClassName,
    config,
    labelKey,
  ]);

  if (!active || !payload?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot";

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "grid min-w-32 items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
        {payload
          .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
          .map((item, index) => {
            const key = `${nameKey ?? item.name ?? item.dataKey ?? "value"}`;
            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
            const indicatorColor = color ?? item.payload?.fill ?? item.color;

            return (
              <div
                key={index}
                className={cn(
                  "flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
                  indicator === "dot" && "items-center",
                )}
              >
                {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
                  formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {itemConfig?.icon ? (
                      <itemConfig.icon />
                    ) : (
                      !hideIndicator && (
                        <div
                          className={cn(
                            "shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-bg)",
                            {
                              "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
                              "w-1": indicator === "line",
                              "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
                                indicator === "dashed",
                              "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
                            },
                          )}
                          style={
                            {
                              "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
                              "--color-border": indicatorColor,
                            } as React.CSSProperties
                          }
                        />
                      )
                    )}
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
                        nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center",
                      )}
                    >
                      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                        {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {itemConfig?.label ?? item.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {item.value != null && (
                        <span className="font-medium text-foreground tabular-nums">
                          {typeof item.value === "number"
                            ? formatInteger(item.value)
                            : String(item.value)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend;

function ChartLegendContent({
  className,
  hideIcon = false,
  payload,
  verticalAlign = "bottom",
  nameKey,
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  hideIcon?: boolean;
  nameKey?: string;
} & RechartsPrimitive.DefaultLegendContentProps) {
  const { config } = useChart();

  if (!payload?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
        verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {payload
        .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
        .map((item, index) => {
          const key = `${nameKey ?? item.dataKey ?? "value"}`;
          const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);

          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
              )}
            >
              {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
                <itemConfig.icon />
              ) : (
                <div
                  className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: item.color,
                  }}
                />
              )}
              {itemConfig?.label}
            </div>
          );
        })}
    </div>
  );
}

function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  config: ChartConfig,
  payload: unknown,
  key: string,
) {
  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    "payload" in payload &&
    typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
    payload.payload !== null
      ? payload.payload
      : undefined;

  let configLabelKey: string = key;

  if (
    key in payload &&
    typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string;
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
      key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
    ] as string;
  }

  return configLabelKey in config ? config[configLabelKey] : config[key];
}

export {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartStyle,
};
```

Leia `src/components/kokonutui/spending-ring.tsx` (o do CLI) e **grave por cima** com Write:

```tsx
"use client";

/**
 * @author: @dorianbaffier
 * @description: Spending Ring
 * @version: 1.0.0
 * @date: 2026-10-15
 * @license: MIT
 * @website: https://kokonutui.com
 * @github: https://github.com/kokonut-labs/kokonutui
 *
 * Adaptado ao Closery (Fase 5, D17): só tokens de cor, pt-BR, sem moeda, o total vem do SQL (o anel
 * nunca soma as fatias), a legenda é uma lista de links (todas as fatias, inclusive as zeradas) e
 * o React Compiler compila o componente (a versão crua o fazia desistir em silêncio).
 */

import Link from "next/link";
import {
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";
import { sharePercent } from "@/features/dashboard/format";
import { formatInteger } from "@/lib/numberFormat";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type RingSlice = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  href: string;
  strokeClass: string;
  dotClass: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
};

export type SpendingRingProps = {
  title: string;
  legendLabel: string;
  total: number;
  slices: readonly RingSlice[];
  emptyText: string;
  className?: string;
};

type RingSpan = { index: number; from: number; to: number };

const SIZE = 240;
const C = SIZE / 2;
const R = 90;
const STROKE = 22;
// Graus deixados vazios entre as fatias e o mínimo de uma fatia com valor (nunca arco invertido).
const GAP = 2.4;
const MIN_SWEEP = 3;
// Mola do ângulo do anel: taxa em rad/s e amortecimento. Um pouco abaixo do crítico, para o
// giro assentar na fatia com uma pequena folga.
const RATE = 11;
const DAMPING = 0.78;
// Quanto à frente um arremesso é projetado ao escolher onde pousa, em segundos.
const PROJECT = 0.2;
// Movimento abaixo disto, em pixels, é um toque, não um giro.
const TAP_SLOP = 5;

/**
 * Onde cada fatia com valor começa e termina, em graus a partir do topo, no sentido horário.
 * Fatias zeradas não desenham; uma fatia pequena nunca fica abaixo de `minSweepDegrees` e a soma
 * dos arcos é sempre 360 − (fatias × vão). Sem `let` reatribuído: o React Compiler não aceita.
 */
export function ringSpans(
  values: readonly number[],
  total: number,
  gapDegrees: number,
  minSweepDegrees: number,
): RingSpan[] {
  const active = values
    .map((value, index) => ({ value, index }))
    .filter(({ value }) => value > 0);
  if (active.length === 0 || total <= 0) {
    return [];
  }
  const usable = 360 - active.length * gapDegrees;
  const raw = active.map(({ value }) => (value / total) * usable);
  const small = raw.filter((sweep) => sweep < minSweepDegrees).length;
  const bigSum = raw
    .filter((sweep) => sweep >= minSweepDegrees)
    .reduce((acc, sweep) => acc + sweep, 0);
  const scale = bigSum > 0 ? (usable - small * minSweepDegrees) / bigSum : 0;
  const sweeps = raw.map((sweep) => {
    if (bigSum === 0) {
      return usable / active.length;
    }
    return sweep < minSweepDegrees ? minSweepDegrees : sweep * scale;
  });
  return active.reduce<RingSpan[]>((acc, { index }, i) => {
    const from = (acc.at(-1)?.to ?? -gapDegrees / 2) + gapDegrees;
    acc.push({ index, from, to: from + sweeps[i] });
    return acc;
  }, []);
}

const midOf = (span: RingSpan) => (span.from + span.to) / 2;

/** Dá a volta no ângulo para -180..180. */
const wrap = (deg: number) => ((((deg + 180) % 360) + 360) % 360) - 180;

/** Um ponto no anel, com 0° no topo e os ângulos crescendo no sentido horário. */
function polar(deg: number, r = R) {
  const rad = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
  return [C + r * Math.sin(rad), C - r * Math.cos(rad)] as const;
}

function arc(from: number, to: number) {
  const [x0, y0] = polar(from);
  const [x1, y1] = polar(to);
  const large = to - from > 180 ? 1 : 0;
  return `M${x0.toFixed(2)} ${y0.toFixed(2)} A${R} ${R} 0 ${large} 1 ${x1.toFixed(2)} ${y1.toFixed(2)}`;
}

/** A fatia mais próxima de um ângulo do anel (o vão entre fatias cai na vizinha). */
function sliceAt(spans: readonly RingSpan[], deg: number) {
  const angle = ((deg % 360) + 360) % 360;
  return spans.reduce(
    (best, span, i) => {
      const distance = Math.abs(wrap(angle - midOf(span)));
      return distance < best.distance ? { index: i, distance } : best;
    },
    { index: 0, distance: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY },
  ).index;
}

/** Um passo de uma mola amortecida, em fatias pequenas para ficar estável. */
function springStep(
  state: { a: number; v: number },
  target: number,
  dt: number,
) {
  const slices = Math.ceil(dt / (1 / 240));
  const h = dt / slices;
  for (let i = 0; i < slices; i++) {
    const accel =
      -RATE * RATE * (state.a - target) - 2 * DAMPING * RATE * state.v;
    state.v += accel * h;
    state.a += state.v * h;
  }
  return Math.abs(state.a - target) < 0.05 && Math.abs(state.v) < 2;
}

const CARD =
  "w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-5 text-card-foreground";

const ROW =
  "flex min-h-9 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs outline-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring motion-reduce:transition-none max-md:min-h-11";

/** A legenda: um link por fatia (todas, inclusive as zeradas), com o número exato. */
function RingLegend({
  legendLabel,
  slices,
  total,
  selectedIndex,
  onSelect,
}: {
  legendLabel: string;
  slices: readonly RingSlice[];
  total: number;
  selectedIndex: number | null;
  onSelect?: (index: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <ul aria-label={legendLabel} className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-1">
      {slices.map((slice, i) => {
        const percent = sharePercent(slice.value, total);
        return (
          <li key={slice.key}>
            <Link
              aria-label={`${slice.label}: ${formatInteger(slice.value)} (${percent}%)`}
              className={cn(
                ROW,
                i === selectedIndex
                  ? "bg-muted"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/60 hover:text-foreground",
              )}
              href={slice.href}
              onFocus={() => onSelect?.(i)}
              onMouseEnter={() => onSelect?.(i)}
            >
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={cn("size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full", slice.dotClass)}
              />
              {slice.icon}
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{slice.label}</span>
              <span className="font-medium tabular-nums">
                {formatInteger(slice.value)}
              </span>
              <span className="w-10 text-right tabular-nums">{percent}%</span>
            </Link>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

/** Sem total (ou sem nenhuma fatia com valor) não há arco para desenhar. */
export function SpendingRing(props: SpendingRingProps) {
  const { title, legendLabel, total, slices, emptyText, className } = props;
  if (total <= 0 || slices.every((slice) => slice.value <= 0)) {
    return (
      <div className={cn(CARD, className)}>
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{title}</p>
          <p className="font-medium text-sm tabular-nums">0</p>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-3 text-muted-foreground text-sm">{emptyText}</p>
        <RingLegend
          legendLabel={legendLabel}
          selectedIndex={null}
          slices={slices}
          total={total}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return <SpendingRingBody {...props} />;
}

function SpendingRingBody({
  title,
  legendLabel,
  total,
  slices,
  className,
}: SpendingRingProps) {
  // Só o que tem valor vira arco; a legenda continua listando todas as fatias.
  const spans = useMemo(
    () =>
      ringSpans(
        slices.map((slice) => slice.value),
        total,
        GAP,
        MIN_SWEEP,
      ),
    [slices, total],
  );
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const ringRef = useRef<SVGGElement>(null);
  const selectedRef = useRef(0);

  // O anel gira para a fatia escolhida ficar sob o marcador, no topo.
  const sim = useRef({
    a: -(spans[0] ? midOf(spans[0]) : 0),
    v: 0,
    target: -(spans[0] ? midOf(spans[0]) : 0),
    raf: 0,
    last: 0,
    // Enquanto um arremesso desliza, a leitura acompanha o que passa pelo marcador.
    coast: false,
    drag: null as null | {
      id: number;
      angle: number;
      time: number;
      moved: number;
      x: number;
      y: number;
    },
  });

  const paint = useCallback(() => {
    ringRef.current?.setAttribute(
      "transform",
      `rotate(${sim.current.a.toFixed(3)} ${C} ${C})`,
    );
  }, []);

  /** Mostra a fatia que está sob o marcador agora. */
  const track = useCallback(() => {
    const index = sliceAt(spans, -sim.current.a);
    if (index !== selectedRef.current) {
      selectedRef.current = index;
      setSelected(index);
    }
  }, [spans]);

  // `requestAnimationFrame(tick)` dentro do próprio useCallback faz o React Compiler desistir do
  // componente: o `tick` se reagenda por uma ref.
  const tickRef = useRef<((now: number) => void) | null>(null);
  const tick = useCallback(
    (now: number) => {
      const s = sim.current;
      s.raf = 0;
      if (s.drag) {
        return;
      }
      const dt = s.last ? Math.min((now - s.last) / 1000, 1 / 30) : 1 / 60;
      s.last = now;
      const state = { a: s.a, v: s.v };
      const settled = springStep(state, s.target, dt);
      s.a = settled ? s.target : state.a;
      s.v = settled ? 0 : state.v;
      paint();
      if (s.coast) {
        track();
      }
      if (settled) {
        s.last = 0;
        s.coast = false;
      } else {
        s.raf = requestAnimationFrame((t) => tickRef.current?.(t));
      }
    },
    [paint, track],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    tickRef.current = tick;
  }, [tick]);

  /**
   * Gira o anel até uma fatia, pelo caminho curto a partir de onde ele pararia sozinho (um
   * arremesso segue para o lado em que foi jogado). O padrão `restAt` é resolvido no corpo: um
   * parâmetro padrão que lê ref faz o React Compiler desistir.
   */
  const turnTo = useCallback(
    (index: number, restAt?: number, coast = false) => {
      const s = sim.current;
      const rest = restAt ?? s.a;
      const span = spans[index];
      const goal = -(span ? midOf(span) : 0);
      s.target = rest + wrap(goal - rest);
      s.coast = coast;
      if (!coast) {
        selectedRef.current = index;
        setSelected(index);
      }
      if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
        s.a = s.target;
        s.v = 0;
        s.coast = false;
        paint();
        track();
        return;
      }
      if (!s.raf) {
        s.last = 0;
        s.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }
    },
    [paint, spans, tick, track],
  );

  // Dado novo mantém a mesma fatia sob o marcador. Um render com os mesmos números num array novo
  // não atrapalha um giro em andamento.
  useEffect(() => {
    const s = sim.current;
    const index = Math.max(0, Math.min(selectedRef.current, spans.length - 1));
    const span = spans[index];
    const goal = -(span ? midOf(span) : 0);
    if (Math.abs(wrap(goal - s.target)) < 0.001) {
      return;
    }
    s.a = goal;
    s.target = goal;
    s.v = 0;
    selectedRef.current = index;
    setSelected(index);
    paint();
  }, [spans, paint]);

  useEffect(() => () => cancelAnimationFrame(sim.current.raf), []);

  const pointerAngle = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2;
    const y = event.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2;
    return (Math.atan2(x, -y) * 180) / Math.PI;
  };

  const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const s = sim.current;
    if (s.drag || (event.pointerType === "mouse" && event.button !== 0)) {
      return;
    }
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
    cancelAnimationFrame(s.raf);
    s.raf = 0;
    s.v = 0;
    s.drag = {
      id: event.pointerId,
      angle: pointerAngle(event),
      time: event.timeStamp,
      moved: 0,
      x: event.clientX,
      y: event.clientY,
    };
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const s = sim.current;
    const drag = s.drag;
    if (!drag || drag.id !== event.pointerId) {
      return;
    }
    drag.moved = Math.max(
      drag.moved,
      Math.hypot(event.clientX - drag.x, event.clientY - drag.y),
    );
    if (drag.moved < TAP_SLOP) {
      return;
    }
    const angle = pointerAngle(event);
    const delta = wrap(angle - drag.angle);
    const dt = Math.max((event.timeStamp - drag.time) / 1000, 1 / 240);
    s.a += delta;
    // Velocidade angular suavizada, para o arremesso ao soltar.
    s.v = s.v * 0.6 + (delta / dt) * 0.4;
    drag.angle = angle;
    drag.time = event.timeStamp;
    setDragging(true);
    paint();
    track();
  };

  const release = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const s = sim.current;
    const drag = s.drag;
    if (!drag || drag.id !== event.pointerId) {
      return;
    }
    s.drag = null;
    setDragging(false);
    if (drag.moved < TAP_SLOP) {
      // Um toque no anel escolhe a fatia sob o dedo; o miolo é só leitura.
      const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
      const r = Math.hypot(
        event.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2,
        event.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2,
      );
      if (r > ((R - STROKE) / SIZE) * rect.width) {
        turnTo(sliceAt(spans, pointerAngle(event) - s.a));
      }
      return;
    }
    // Um giro parado antes de soltar não tem arremesso.
    if (event.timeStamp - drag.time > 80) {
      s.v = 0;
    }
    s.v = Math.max(-1440, Math.min(1440, s.v));
    const rest = s.a + s.v * PROJECT;
    turnTo(sliceAt(spans, -rest), rest, true);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const step: Record<string, number> = {
      ArrowRight: 1,
      ArrowDown: 1,
      ArrowLeft: -1,
      ArrowUp: -1,
    };
    let next: number | null = null;
    if (event.key in step) {
      next = (selected + step[event.key] + spans.length) % spans.length;
    } else if (event.key === "Home") {
      next = 0;
    } else if (event.key === "End") {
      next = spans.length - 1;
    }
    if (next !== null) {
      event.preventDefault();
      turnTo(next);
    }
  };

  /** Foco ou passagem do mouse numa linha da legenda gira o anel até a fatia dela. */
  const selectSlice = (sliceIndex: number) => {
    const position = spans.findIndex((span) => span.index === sliceIndex);
    if (position !== -1 && position !== selectedRef.current) {
      turnTo(position);
    }
  };

  const currentSpan = spans[selected];
  const current = currentSpan ? slices[currentSpan.index] : undefined;
  const share = current ? sharePercent(current.value, total) : 0;
  const selectedSliceIndex = currentSpan ? currentSpan.index : null;

  return (
    <div className={cn(CARD, className)}>
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4">
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{title}</p>
        <p className="font-medium text-sm tabular-nums">
          {formatInteger(total)}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div
        aria-label={`${title}. Use as setas para girar o anel.`}
        aria-valuemax={spans.length}
        aria-valuemin={1}
        aria-valuenow={selected + 1}
        aria-valuetext={
          current
            ? `${current.label}: ${formatInteger(current.value)} (${share}%)`
            : ""
        }
        className={cn(
          "relative mx-auto mt-3 aspect-square w-full max-w-[240px] touch-none select-none rounded-full outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-4 focus-visible:ring-offset-background",
          dragging ? "cursor-grabbing" : "cursor-grab",
        )}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onLostPointerCapture={release}
        onPointerCancel={release}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
        onPointerUp={release}
        role="slider"
        tabIndex={0}
      >
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="absolute inset-0 size-full"
          viewBox={`0 0 ${SIZE} ${SIZE}`}
        >
          <g
            ref={ringRef}
            transform={`rotate(${-(spans[0] ? midOf(spans[0]) : 0)} ${C} ${C})`}
          >
            {spans.map((span, i) => {
              const slice = slices[span.index];
              return (
                <path
                  className={cn(
                    "transition-[stroke-width,opacity] duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none",
                    slice.strokeClass,
                    i !== selected && "opacity-40 dark:opacity-50",
                  )}
                  d={arc(span.from, span.to)}
                  fill="none"
                  key={slice.key}
                  strokeWidth={i === selected ? STROKE + 8 : STROKE}
                />
              );
            })}
          </g>
          {/* O marcador para onde o anel gira as fatias. */}
          <path
            className="fill-foreground"
            d={`M${C - 5} 2 L${C + 5} 2 L${C} 8 Z`}
          />
        </svg>

        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
          <div
            className="starting:translate-y-1 starting:opacity-0 transition-[opacity,translate] duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none"
            key={current?.key}
          >
            <p className="mt-0.5 font-semibold text-2xl tabular-nums tracking-tight">
              {current ? formatInteger(current.value) : ""}
            </p>
            <p className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground text-xs">
              <span
                className={cn("size-1.5 rounded-full", current?.dotClass)}
              />
              {current?.label}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-muted-foreground text-xs tabular-nums">
              {share}% do total
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <RingLegend
        legendLabel={legendLabel}
        onSelect={selectSlice}
        selectedIndex={selectedSliceIndex}
        slices={slices}
        total={total}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
